name: False doctrine
about: False gospels, false prophets and false churches.

teachings.title: Their drink offerings of blood: the Mass refuted
teachings.summary: Roman Catholic drink offerings and repeated sacrifice of the Mass are offerings to another god, while Christ's blood was offered once for all.
teachings.text:
Continuing in **Psalm 16**, David calls out the vanity and ultimate end of those that call not upon the Lord for salvation. Who go after another god.

They make drink offerings of blood, and speak other names in their prayers.

The most prominent example of this today is Roman Catholicism. They make drink offerings, claiming it to be the blood of Christ, profaning His name, and bow to and serve idols representing their own gods.

But for the saved, the Lord is our inheritance, we are co-heirs with Christ the Bible says, and He is our cup, the blood shed for us on the cross:

**Luke 22:20**
*Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.*

The very new testament which we preach is founded upon the blood shed by Jesus. Not a chalice of gold held up by a priest to an image, sacrificing Jesus daily, as if that were possible or necessary, to call Him down from heaven again.

And it is God that maintains our lot. Who holds us by His power. Not carnal sacrifices made over and over again.

**Hebrews 10:10–14**
*By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all. And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God; From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool. For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.*

This is our goodly heritage. This is the promise of God. The Son at the right hand of the Father. We shall not be moved. And so we rejoice.

We rest in hope.

teachings.title: Jeroboam's religion a picture of Rome
teachings.summary: The long-lived false religion of Jeroboam with its idols, feasts and priesthood is a prophetic sign of the Roman Catholic Church and its offshoots, which God will destroy.
teachings.text:
Continuing the preaching of Amos against the Northern Kingdom of Israel, especially against the false religion of Jeroboam.

The Lord shows Amos a basket of summer fruit. The early harvest. Those He has gathered unto Himself. Like the wheat in the dream of the grasshopper, the vision of the fall harvest being devoured before it springs fully up, the Lord says that He shall pass again no more.

Israel is being cut off in unbelief. The word of God taken from their hearts. Ears made dull for hearing. And all those who swore by the false idols, the Sin of Samaria, shall fall and never rise again.

This false religion of Jeroboam, which lasted hundreds of years and flourished, even as the true religion in Judea waxed and waned. This is a prophetic sign of the Roman Catholic Church, and its Orthodox and mainline Protestant churches.

They set up false idols, claimed they were the living God, made up their own feasts, and ceremony, priesthood and sacrifices. Keeping their vain traditions and so God shut up their hearts to the truth.

In the end His judgment is upon them and they will be utterly destroyed. Now as then.

teachings.title: Korah's company the first ecumenical council
teachings.summary: Korah's rebellion is like Rome's councils, adding the traditions of men such as baptismal regeneration, infant baptism and idols to God's word.
teachings.text:
Oh, one more thing regarding **Numbers 16** and the rebellion of Koreh and the 250 priests and their plan to usurp the order established by the word of God. This could be considered the first ecumenical council, like those of the Catholic Church. And like those councils of men, who added to or distorted the doctrines of faith given in scripture - heresies like "baptismal regeneration," infant baptism, the allowance of images and idols, Mariology and the worship of saints...These heresies fly in the face of clear Biblical fundamentalism, and instead lean on *the gainsaying of Core*. The ideas and traditions of men.

It is impossible to not see how God views these wicked men and their false doctrines of devils.

teachings.title: The queen of heaven and Mary worship
teachings.summary: The worship of the queen of heaven, in Judah and in Rome's Mary worship, crept in through women seeking spiritualism and men who allowed it rather than keep God's order.
teachings.text:
Let all the children of the Catholic Church, who are so very dear to us, hear these words of ours. With a still more ardent zeal for piety, religion and love, let them continue to venerate, invoke and pray to the most Blessed Virgin Mary, Mother of God, conceived without original sin. Let them fly with utter confidence to this most sweet Mother of mercy and grace in all dangers, difficulties, needs, doubts and fears. Under her guidance, under her patronage, under her kindness and protection, nothing is to be feared; nothing is hopeless. Because, while bearing toward us a truly motherly affection and having in her care the work of our salvation, she is solicitous about the whole human race. And since she has been appointed by God to be the Queen of heaven and earth, and is exalted above all the choirs of angels and saints, and even stands at the right hand of her only-begotten Son, Jesus Christ our Lord, she presents our petitions in a most efficacious manner. What she asks, she obtains. Her pleas can never be unheard.
- *Ineffabilis Deus* (1854), Pope Pius IX

The worship of the queen of heaven, in every time and place, comes from the pressure of women upon their husbands, because rather than obey the hierarchy of God, men submit to their wives to keep peace at home, and heresy abounds.

The worship of Mary by Catholics crept in, over time, and because women drove it seeking spiritualism rather than the Spirit, and carnal feelings rather than the knowledge of God. They were the ones who read the forgeries of the false gospels. They felt a need for burning incense and candles, to "feel" closer to the spiritual. They drove the venerating of icons. They drove the devotion to idols. And ultimately, the Roman Catholic Church adopted what it had seen as heresy, as dogma.

Even today, the devil works on women with false teachings, appeals to emotion and contradicting God's word, so that, like Adam and Solomon, men may be led to sin.

Just as it was in Judah during Jeremiah's day.

This is not to lay blame at the women's feet. Because it is the men that suffer such things and who bring it from superstitious acts of their wives, to full on practice of their own. Willingly turning to sin.

teachings.title: Mary as co-redeemer and the cult of the queen
teachings.summary: Rome makes Mary a co-redeemer and mediatrix, no different from the Jews in Egypt who credited the queen of heaven, and such idolatry brings nations to destruction.
teachings.text:
Tradition dictates that Mary is part of the monarchy of heaven, soliciting grace and mercy from the Lord on behalf of sinners, and covering sin by distributing from her "Treasury of Merit." She becomes a "co-redeemer" with Christ in His suffering on the cross, and is now a "co-mediator" alongside Him in heaven—essentially an alternative avenue of access to God. They blasphemously replace the Holy Spirit and His role in bestowing aid and comfort to believers with Mary. In effect, she becomes an additional member of the Trinity. The Mother of God. The Queen of Heaven. Mediatrix. And they pray to her for salvation.

There's very little difference in this and the attitudes of the Jews in Egypt, who credited their worship of the "queen of heaven" for their prosperity, and their halfhearted turn towards the true and living God as the cause for their calamity.

And so God vows to destroy them, and does.

Again, I have posted about this before but it bears repeating; It is the people calling themselves by His name who worship idols and profane God that leads to a nation's destruction. The West is currently paying the price for the return of the cult of the queen.

teachings.title: Cakes to the queen of heaven
teachings.summary: Jeremiah 7 condemns sacraments over faith and specifically the worship of the queen of heaven, which Catholic Bibles annotate away.
teachings.text:
Let's not overlook the obvious; that God not only rebukes those who seek to be justified by their sacraments and ceremony, of vain works that betray their adulterous hearts, but also gives specific example of the Idolatry these supposed children of God have added to their worship.

*The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead their dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto other gods, that they may provoke me to anger. Do they provoke me to anger? saith the Lord: do they not provoke themselves to the confusion of their own faces?*

The preaching in chapter 7 destroys the idea of sacraments over faith, works over belief, and the serving of idols, specifically the worship of "the queen of heaven."

Of course the Catholic perversion of the Bible, the Douay–Rheims, has to include a note about this mention of the false god the people baked cakes to, holding feasts for. Because otherwise, someone might question this if they read it.

teachings.title: The Lord's supper versus Catholic communion
teachings.summary: Since God forbids eating blood and Jesus called the cup the fruit of the vine, the Lord's supper is a remembrance and the Catholic mass is a pagan perversion.
teachings.text:
In **Leviticus 17**, God reiterates His command that the children of Israel not consume blood. As we see from **Genesis 9** and **Acts 15**, this command predates the Levitical laws, and extends to the New Testament, where believers are told to not only abstain from consuming blood, but also food offered to idols.

The blood, the life thereof, *whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.*

We see in the ordinance of the Lord's supper, the remembrance of Christ's death and the new testament of His blood shed for the remission of sin.

**Matthew 26:26-29**
*And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body. And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink ye all of it; For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins. But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom.*

Now, knowing that the consumption of blood is an abomination to the Lord, cutting off someone from being a child of Israel, and that the law against it is not done away with the end of the Levitical ceremonial laws and ordinances, predating them, and being commanded by the apostles to the Gentiles, is there a contradiction?

Since God is not the author of confusion, and Jesus Himself says that this cup is still just grape juice after His blessing, *this fruit of the vine*, no.

It is a form of materialist literalism that has a false doctrine that the bread literally turns to flesh and the juice literally becomes blood when their priests offer up wine and crackers to idols. The Catholic hocus pocus is Nicodemus-level in missing the spiritual application and meaning, to turn Christianity into a cannibal cult.

In the Catholic religion, they call the offering of the bread and alcoholic wine, lifted up to graven images "a sacrifice." They pray to their idol that it be acceptable as a sacrifice. They consume meat offered to idols, and in their hearts, consume what they will claim is blood.

It is a wicked pagan perversion of what should be a simple remembrance:

**Luke 22:14-20**
*And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him. And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer: For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God. And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves: For I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come. And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me. Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.*

What should be a sobering and holy remembrance is turned into an abomination and a mockery by the heathen practice of a Catholic communion.

teachings.title: Good person, mass and purgatory cope
teachings.summary: Those trusting works claim to be good people yet call assurance presumption and invent purgatory, because they will not admit they are sinners deserving Hell.
teachings.text:
Talk with them, soul winning and even online, and they will say they know they are going to heaven because they are a "good person," or that they attend mass and take communion and go to confession. But in the back of their mind they know this isn't true, that they imperfectly follow the law of God, and even fall short of the traditions of man. And so they will hedge by saying it is presumption to claim to know if you're saved. That they "think so, but God decides at judgment." That unbiblical things like purgatory exist as a Plan B is a testament to the cope people will cling to to deny that they are sinners deserving death and Hell.

And the Gospel reminds them of this, triggers them, and their anger has resulted in persecution and murder of martyrs, just as the prophets slain in the OT times. Just as it did Christ. Just as it did the apostles and the early church and through the dark ages.

Man doesn't want to humble themselves to the truth of their nature and what they deserve. They seek reassurance that they are good. That they deserve salvation.

But we know this isn't true.

teachings.title: Thou hast the words of eternal life
teachings.summary: Peter understood that Christ's words, not literal flesh and blood, give eternal life, so those who teach literally eating Christ's body for salvation are not saved, and John 6 does not teach Calvinism.
teachings.text:
*Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away? Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life. And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.*

So we see that Peter understood the lesson. Peter was saved by faith, speaks the truth of what Jesus was conveying; that Jesus has the words of eternal life. Not the literal flesh and blood to consume to obtain it, but the words that by faith grant the believer eternal life, because Jesus is the Christ, the son of the living God.

This teaching is an excellent way to separate the believer from those who aren't. Jesus uses it to divide, to alienate and offend those who don't understand the spiritual application because they are there to have their bellies filled, or to see wonders, not because they seek salvation.

This still applies today. People who take any sort of literal view of actually eating the body and drinking the blood of Jesus to gain salvation are not saved and have not come to the knowledge of the truth. They are not called according to God's will, because they aren't seeking to know or understand it.

Don't get that twisted, though. This isn't an appeal to Calvinism. Again, **John 6** is a stumbling block for the unbelieving who use the "called" to teach their limited atonement damnable heresy.

*For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me. And this is the Father's will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day. And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.*

teachings.title: Penance is an affront to the gospel of grace
teachings.summary: Lenten penance contradicts salvation by grace and the finished work of Christ; fasting is to grow in God's will, not to pay for sins Jesus already paid.
teachings.text:
Another "Lenten" reminder that the concept of penance for sin is in direct contradiction with salvation by grace, and a slap in the face to the finished work of Jesus Christ, who died and suffered Hell for our sins that we may be forgiven.

Fasting is meant to help a saved Christian better understand the will of God that their faith grows, that they may accept it and do that will, to the benefit of others. To feed the spiritual new man by neglecting the old man of the flesh.

It is not to give "penance" for the sins Jesus already paid the price for, in a selfish effort to obtain forgiveness which is given to us freely by the grace of God.

The Bible says telling people to abstain from certain foods as a means of holiness is a doctrine of devils. The idea of penance doesn't exist in scripture. In fact, it is an affront to the Gospel of grace.

Reject these doctrines of devils and rely on the perfect work of Christ alone as the propitiation for your sin.

teachings.title: Penance is not in scripture
teachings.summary: The word penance is not in scripture, and the Catholic NAB inserts it into Isaiah 58:5, a passage where God calls such practices sin.
teachings.text:
BTW, the term "penance" doesn't appear anywhere in scripture, even in the more corrupt modern versions, but Catholics draw their proof text from **Isaiah 58:5**, a chapter as we just saw that explicitly has God calling such practices sin.

The New American Bible (NAB), a popular Catholic perversion of the word, twists the scripture and changes "afflict [your] soul" to "penance": “Is this the manner of fasting I wish, of keeping a day of penance: That a man bow his head like a reed, and lie in sackcloth and ashes? Do you call this a fast, a day acceptable to the LORD?”

They don't even see the folly of using this, in its actual context, to justify the idea, or promote the yoke of abstinence and fasting, ashes and self- that God is literally telling Isaiah to preach against.

They take from it only that they were being insincere, not that God calls us to delight in His day of rest, to celebrate the sabbath we have in Christ, and do for others that He be glorified. Only that the Hebrews just went about self flagellation wrong.

teachings.title: Making a physical idol of spiritual pictures
teachings.summary: False teachers take parables and pictures literally out of context and build doctrines of devils on them, such as infant sprinkling, sacramental bread and wine and praying to saints.
teachings.text:
This study is the meat of the word, it's hard for many to digest. The vain traditions of those who claim Christ but teach their own wisdom, rejecting the word of God as the only authority and twisting scripture to defend their doctrines of devils, has beguiled many.

And so we are warned;

*Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind.*

(BTW, that goes for praying to dead "saints," as angels)

People take doctrine from out of context verses, or partial text, and using the logic of man, puffed up in their fleshly mind, work out by fallacious implications that their heretical doctrines are actually Biblical.

They fail to square plainly stated and often repeated clear doctrines that directly contradict their own. They take literal readings of parables that they don't understand, and apply their carnal mind to the Spirit.

They are like Nicodemus, the Pharisee who questioned Jesus in **John 3**, unable to understand the parables about being born twice, once of water from the womb, again in Spirit, reborn by faith.

 They become like the disciples offended by His parable in **John 6**, where He compares Himself to manna, bread come down from Heaven that we must "eat." They thought this was some sort of cannibalistic blasphemy, despite Jesus explaining "*It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.*"

Even today, many take parables and metaphors, pictures of the spiritual and make for themselves a physical idol of it. Missing the point.

And so you have denominations claiming to believe that salvation is by faith alone, still maintaining that sprinkling of infants and ritualistic eating of bread and drinking of wine bestows salvation, or keeps it. That works must be done to shore up that which is by faith alone. The contradictions lost on them, as is salvation.

teachings.title: Mary was saved by faith alone
teachings.summary: Luke records no immaculate conception; Mary was blessed and counted righteous by faith like every saint, so those who worship Mary miss God's grace.
teachings.text:
I would note that the gospel of Luke is the most thorough regarding the nativity of Jesus. It's what Linus quotes from in the Charlie Brown Christmas special. It's often what we think of and read from at Christmas time. And as Luke writes, this is a *declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us.*

And so we should notice what is absent. Those things which are not commonly believed among the first century Christians to whom this gospel is addressed.

There is no mention of the immaculate conception of Mary. There is no indication she was born without sin. While she exclaims in the Spirit that future generations shall call her blessed, it isn't because of a special quality of her's, but by the works of God to whom she's a servant. Mary does the will of God through faith, and in faith is blessed among women to be chosen to bear the incarnation of Christ Jesus. This is the grace that God bestows upon her for her faith. For her willingness to believe.

Just like the Old Testament saints, Mary believed and it was counted upon her for righteousness. She was saved by faith alone and chosen because of that faith.

The Bible says that without faith we cannot please God. Mary could not please God without faith. Zacharias and Elizabeth could not please God without faith. None of them could be righteous absent their belief that God has provided them remission of sins in his mercy. Given the gift of salvation from His grace.

Removing this concept from the gospel, those that worship Mary missed the entire point and so they cannot understand God's mercy and they cannot receive God's grace.

teachings.title: Judaizers and Rome Rebuild the Veil
teachings.summary: Hebrews refutes the Judaizers, and today Zionism, Hebrew roots and Rome likewise put priests and ordinances between man and God, though Christ is the only High Priest.
teachings.text:
God's message to the Hebrews, explaining the need for the end of the Mosaic law, the Levitical priesthood and the carnal ordinances comes to give these 1st century Hebrews confidence to reject the call to return to the vain traditions of man that many Jews were pushing early believers towards. The Judaizers who we see in Acts and the epistles persecuting and infiltrating the churches of the time seeking to return Christians to bondage under the law. Circumcision was a large part of it, but there were those claiming that they needed priests, sacrifice at the temple, to keep the days and feasts. The diverse washings. The vain traditions of man that became the Pharisaical laws.

But repeatedly, again and again, the Bible shows us this being reproved. That this was replaced in Christ and the liberty which was purchased by His blood upon the mercy seat in Heaven. Not a temple made by hands but that spiritual tabernacle in Heaven.

And even so, today, there are Judaizers among us, creeping in unawares. Bringing things like Zionism, "Hebrew roots," and other heresies to bring the believer back under the yoke of the law.

Further, we have established cults from the whore of Babylon in Rome and its harlot daughters, that seek to mend the veil and rebuild the earthly tabernacle, made by their own evil hands. To separate man from God again through their own priests, carnal ordinances, feasts and days. Bloodless redemption though human mediators. Grace doled out by weekly sacrifices. Dead works as a means of satisfying transgressions of the law which they yoke their followers with.

They *compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.*

They say "call us father," "Papa." Padre. Pope.
When Jesus said "*call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven."*

They place themselves between God and man to prevent the will of the Father, and the offer of the free gift of salvation, eternal life given by grace through faith.

But the letter to the Hebrews, from God through the Spirit, promises us that we have A, singular, High Priest after the order of Melchisedec, that in Christ Jesus we are forgiven our sins, adopted into the inheritance, and free to boldly go before the throne of God, directly to the Father, in the name of the Son. The Son Who isn't ashamed to call us brethren. Amen!

This is the better testament. This is the good news. Let no man prevent you. Now is the hour of salvation. Be born again unto eternal life. Repent from dead works to serve the living God.

teachings.title: Rome denies the liberty that is in Christ
teachings.summary: The Roman Catholic Church and her daughters keep people yoked to works for justification, the error of Cain, denying the liberty of Christ.
teachings.text:
What the whore of Babylon, the Roman Catholic Church and its prot harlot daughters do is deny the liberty to the law that is in Christ Jesus, so that its adherents stay yoked to trying to justify themselves before God in their works.

But to we who are free in Christ by the free gift of salvation, we willingly become servants for righteousness, sanctifying ourselves, denying the flesh and walking in the spirit.

By denying the liberty, they damn those following their perverse false doctrine. And by relying on their vain works, they receive nothing but death and Hell, being debtors to the whole of the law.

*Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.*

God's word describes the man who seeks to be justified by dead works and adherence to the law as under bondage. Satan tells us that our feeble attempts at our own righteousness is sufficient. The error of Cain. But God says our righteousness are as filthy rags. Wood, hay and stubble.

And just as He rejected Cain's works and accepted Abel's offering of faith, so too it is for us today.

teachings.title: Worshipping God in vain by the traditions of men
teachings.summary: Like the Pharisees, the Catholic Church and her daughters leave God's commandments for man-made rituals and seek grace doled out by men.
teachings.text:
The repudiation of following what is the tradition of men, worshiping God in vain, continues. Jesus Christ in condemning the hypocrisy of the Pharisees gives us insight to all who are like them, leaving the commandments of God to embrace the traditions of man, and lose their way. Such is the Catholic Church today. So to its daughters. Making their own commandments and rituals, which do nothing spiritually for them, which don't please God, and often bring His wrath. Leaving the Biblical doctrines God has given us to chase idols and false sacrament, rites and rituals of pagans. Seeking to be given grace by increments, doled out by men rather than God.

So to here, the Pharisees and scribes come to accuse the disciples for not engaging in ritual hand washing prior to eating which was their human tradition, not a command of God. Jesus calls them out on this hypocrisy.

Jesus points out that these vipers have condoned men dishonoring their parents, by declaring their own wealth to be "Corban" that is, belonging to God (despite their keeping it and using it for themselves), cutting off their parents from support which God commands us to provide. ([See Matthew 15 parallel study](https://t.me/HouseOfWews2/5226))

teachings.title: Doctrines of devils: forbidding to marry
teachings.summary: The Spirit expressly foretold departures teaching forbidding to marry and abstaining from meats, doctrines of devils later taken up by the Roman Catholic Church.
teachings.text:
Paul, expressly speaking in the Spirit, warns that in the latter times, the period post-ascension and before the day of the Lord's return, that some will depart from the faith, to teach doctrines of devils.

The Holy Spirit describes these false prophets as having their conscience seared, because they are reprobates, and so they speak lies and hypocrisy.

Again, this isn't Paul's spiritual discernment leading to his writing a prophetic dark saying, he says this is directly spoken by the Spirit, by God. And these are the examples of what those devilish doctrines of lies will teach; Forbidding to marry and abstaining from meats, insinuating that they will deceive those giving heed to seducing spirits, with the appearance of holiness.

It shouldn't have to be said that this is directed at the same heresies the RCC would eventually take up. Their doctrines of devils.

This is one of many admonitions against specific practices that the Catholic Church and many of its harlot daughters teach. Warnings against Idolatry, building ornate temples, vain repetitive prayers, having other mediators with God the Father than the man Christ Jesus, calling men "Father," taking heed to Jewish fables, adding works and "sacraments" to the Gospel, disregarding God's word as the only source for doctrine, persecution of believers, and here, forbidding to marry and abstaining from meats.

As if that were not enough, there is Scripture recording Jesus saying to those seeking to worship Mary, "*Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it*." and "*Who is my mother, or my brethren?...Behold my mother and my brethren! For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother."*

The word of God, spoken before the foundation of the world, and published in these latter times, expressly addresses the false teachers and their doctrines of what Jesus' revelation to John calls "the whore of Babylon." More than 200 years before the Roman empire created the Catholic Church. And still today some take heed of its seducing spirits and are led astray.

teachings.title: The leaven of the Pharisees is their doctrine
teachings.summary: Jesus uses bread for the word and leaven for false doctrine, and natural men who take it literally turn it into a materialistic cannibal sacrament.
teachings.text:
Matthew 16, the chapter that contains the one half-sentence, stripped of all context and twisted into blasphemy, that Catholics use to justify the false church's existence.

It is an interesting chapter, serving as a transition for Jesus' earthly ministry from service to the masses, finding the lost sheep, to preparing for the end, the death burial and resurrection.

It begins as most of Matthew, with a short story of Pharisees and Sadducees and scribes, coming to Jesus and attempting to trap Him or trick Him with leading questions, this time again asking Jesus to perform some kind of sign, and again He rebukes them that they should see the sign of the times all around them, but perceiving not the things of God, the only sign that will be given them is the sign of Jonas, signifying His approaching fate and triumphant resurrection following 3 days and 3 nights in Hell.

And, as throughout Matthew, Jesus takes the opportunity to preach, here teaching His Apostles, saying beware the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees. The apostles, who we are told were focused on their forgetting bread for the journey, questioned if He was talking about actual bread, literal food, and their lack of it. Jesus reproaching them to focus on what He's teaching, spiritual things, and to not worry about he material. Didn't He just feed thousands, repeatedly, with physical bread? He wants them to focus on the spiritual aspect of His parable.

*How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees? Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.*

Jesus repeatedly uses bread as an allegory for the word of God, for scripture and for doctrine being taught. The daily wisdom from God's word we are to pray for. The bread from Heaven that if we should eat, never hunger again. That gives eternal life. It is spiritual, not actual wheat and water. And the leaven, which often represents sin in these parables, is the false teaching and doctrines of the Pharisees and Sadducees, which infecting the "lump," the "dough" of proper doctrine, will grow and spread, corrupting it.

Natural man misunderstanding, making Jesus' parables using bread as imagery, cannot grasp that He is speaking of spiritual things, of God and His doctrine. That man lives not by bread alone but by every word of the living God. That Jesus, like mana, is the the bread to come down from Heaven, giving eternal life to all who partake in it. That the flesh profits nothing, that this is spiritual.

And, lacking discernment, the natural man proceeds to turn what is an eloquent teaching moment preached to us by the Son of God, into a materialistic cannibal-cult ritual. That little leaven of misunderstanding infecting the whole lump with its yeast, and creating a worldly sacrament that people put their faith in rather than the word of God.

teachings.title: Get thee behind me, Satan: the first pope rebuked
teachings.summary: Peter's rebuke right after his confession shows he held no special position, and a materialistic, literal religion of relics, wine and vestments savours the things of men and is satanic.
teachings.text:
Just a few verses later, Peter, their "first pope," foolishly protests the fate Christ has revealed unto them, that Jesus should suffer and die by the Jews in Jerusalem.

Jesus rebukes him by calling him Satan, "for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men."

The juxtaposition of the two events in rapid succession, divinely inspired to show precisely that Peter was not anything special by way of position. He's just a stand-in for us as we struggle with our faith and understanding.

And once again Jesus makes a point of the difference between the spiritual things of God, which is His focus, and the things of man. Not being able to rightly divide the word of God, and applying earthly things to spiritual Doctrine, a natural man understanding, is satanic. A materialistic literal interpretation of scripture is from the devil. And you can see in the false doctrines of men and their vain traditions, all revolve around the material. The physical penance, the actual bread and wine, the graven images and statues and idolatry, the vestments and fancy architecture, offices and vestments, and accumulation of gold and silver and treasure by the church... It is all satanic because it is all material, not spiritual.

teachings.title: Faith in things unseen against material religion
teachings.summary: Faith is the evidence of things unseen, and the world's religions need idols, crackers, priesthoods and temples because they are materialistic and cannot save.
teachings.text:
This reminds me of Reinhardt study of Hebrews that's going on now on his channel, and it rem6 how in [Hebrews chapter 11](https://t.me/HouseOfWews2/5206) we see the focus of faith over literally seeing something, that Moses and the other examples accepted things on food, which is the evidence of things unseen. In their hearts they believed what God was telling them. They didn't need to see it physically in order to believe.

It's the same application, the understanding that the things Jesus is teaching us on are not things of this world. It's not an earthly kingdom, but I have a new one. It's not eternal life of our corruptible flesh by eating literally bread or his literal flesh, but the spirit that quickens from accepting the word in our hearts.

The religions of this world are materialistic and unable to bring people to salvation, eternal life, through faith in the unseen.

It's why they need to use idols and images, bowing to statues and graven things. Eating crackers and cubes of bread. Drinking alcohol and believing it's really blood.

It's why they need temples built by hand filled with treasures of the Earth. It's why they need works, good deeds and attempts to turn from sin that are visible to all. It's why they pray vain repetitions in public, using worry beads, thinking they'll be heard by much speaking as the heathen do.

It's why they need an actual priesthood, of monks in vestments and robes, silly hats identifying offices of an earthly organization.

It's all materialism and it's all prayers for the god of this world.

teachings.title: Trent's anathema on faith alone
teachings.summary: The Council of Trent's curse on justification by faith alone puts the Catholic Church against the Bible, which teaches salvation by grace through faith without works.
teachings.text:
The Council of Trent, on salvation by faith alone:

CANON IX.-If any one saith, that by faith alone the impious is justified; in such wise as to mean, that nothing else is required to co-operate in order to the obtaining the grace of Justification, and that it is not in any way necessary, that he be prepared and disposed by the movement of his own will; let him be anathema

CANON XII.-If any one saith, that justifying faith is nothing else but confidence in the divine mercy which remits sins for Christ’s sake; or, that this confidence alone is that whereby we are justified; let him be anathema.

The Bible is anathema to the Catholic Church. Jesus Christ Himself, and Paul, Peter, James, all heretics and anathema to them.

**John 5:24**
*Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.*

**Romans 11:6**
*And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.*

**Romans 3:20**
*Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.*

**Ephesians 2:8**
 *For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God.*

**John 3:16**
*For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.*

teachings.title: Hell is real, and Mary had other children
teachings.summary: Jesus preached Hell often, and Matthew 13 names Jesus' brothers and sisters, refuting Mary's perpetual virginity.
teachings.text:
And when Jesus says that the tares should be burned in the fire, the wailing and gnashing of teeth, he is preaching on Hell. Those falsely claiming there is no Hell, or that Christ didn't talk about it are lying. He does frequently, yet many whose heart is by the wayside, or even the stoney ground, blindly believe the lies, having no root in the truth of the word.

As for the Mary worshipers, another L.

*Is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?* *And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?*

His half-brothers and sisters, Mary not a perpetual virgin. Sick and twisted false doctrine rebuked, amen.

teachings.title: Rome is shifting sand
teachings.summary: The Catholic church adds to God's word and changes doctrine with the times, so it is shifting sand that cannot be a foundation for faith.
teachings.text:
I know it's difficult to hear that the Catholic church is not a rock, it's not even a stone like peter, it is a shifting ever-changing, false religion that has added doctrines at the whims of what's popular, even going against earlier declarations of heresy. They add to the word of God, and because of this, you cannot base your beliefs on it the way you can biblical fundamentalism. Because they'll pull the rug right out from under you. The rushing rivers of time will move you because it is a shifting sand false religion.

Whatever good you might feel like you get out of it, you're missing out on everything God has in store for believers by clinging to these vain traditions of men.

teachings.title: The bread of life is not a wafer
teachings.summary: Jesus' eating His flesh means believing on His sacrifice, so transubstantiation and real-presence sacraments are carnal misreadings like Nicodemus's.
teachings.text:
So now, again, the Jews and especially the Pharisees among them, being natural men and not understanding the spiritual things of God, fail the test of understanding that Jesus held out to them, and so He moves further from the milk of the word to the meat. For if they cannot understand the simple things and the parables and analogies, then Jesus may as well preach harder things and more difficult, dark sayings.

*Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.* They don't get it.

*I am that bread of life.* Nope. They can't understand.

*Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead. This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die. I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.*

Here Jesus gives the full Gospel, and compares it again to the manna from Heaven which fed the body, but not the soul. He explains his flesh, his actual physical body will be sacrificed on the cross, that He'll die physically to bring salvation to the world, that that is the way he is the bread of life. How spiritual bread can be His flesh.

And again, like Nicodemus, the Jews do not understand the spiritual things of God, being natural men. And instead they take it literally to mean actually eating bread that is made of his flesh. They turn what is basic salvation into cannibalism in their lack of understanding.

Many denominations today take that literal approach to what Jesus is saying, and make a sacrament of literally feeding their belly with literal bread that they claim is literally flesh. Some, like the catholics, invented a doctrine of Hocus pocus, that the priest blessing their wafers and alcohol miraculously turns it into literal flesh and literal blood that must be consumed by the body in order to be spiritually saved. That's wicked as hell.

Other denominations try to split down the middle and claim that while yes, it is symbolic, it's still "the real presence of Jesus," and necessary for salvation to consume earthly bread and earthly alcohol or juice. They may as well be crawling up inside their mother's womb to be born again, these foolish Nicodemuses.

By the way, the Bible says that wherever two or three are present in his name, the real presence of Jesus is there. Not inside a wafer or a cracker or a crouton.

teachings.title: Born of water is the first birth
teachings.summary: In John 3:5 being born of water means natural birth, as verse 6 explains, not baptism, so baptism is no part of being born again.
teachings.text:
Oh one more point of Doctrine from John 3, there are some who like nicodemus, can't understand scripture and so isolate verse 5, out of context, and claim that baptism is part of being born again. That Jesus is saying we must be born both of water, meaning baptism, as well as the Spirit. As we can tell by looking at the entire chapter in context, that's not what's being said at all. Verse 6 explains verse 5, Jesus is saying that we're being born again, because we've already been born once in the flesh, in the water of our birth. So being born in the spirit is our second birth.

Like all bad doctrine, it requires someone to take an autistically literal interpretation of isolated verses, and are as foolish as Nicodemus saying we'd have to crawl back inside our mother to be born again.

teachings.title: Dumb idols and the Lord in His holy temple
teachings.summary: Idolatry is vanity, and those who bow, pray and light candles to statues today are as foolish as the idol makers, for the living God is not found in man's handiwork.
teachings.text:
Finally, Habakkuk receives this gem;

*What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusteth therein, to make dumb idols? Woe unto him that saith to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise, it shall teach! Behold, it is laid over with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all in the midst of it. But the Lord is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.*

The truth of idolatry is its vanity. The idea that man can make a god of his own hands. That there is even a fraction of divinity and power in them is foolishness.

And the people who today bow and serve idols, kneeling and offering prayers to them, lighting candles and incense and telling themselves that these lifeless statutes and carvings and molten images are a representation of the holy or divine are just as foolish as the maker of heaven images described here by the Lord.

God is in His temple, sitting on His throne. Our God lives, and is not found in anything created by man's hands or in temples made of stone. The earth is His footstool. All creation is a testament to His power.

teachings.title: Hezekiah broke the brazen serpent Nehushtan
teachings.summary: The brazen serpent was a picture of Christ lifted up, but Hezekiah rightly destroyed it when it was worshipped, refuting Catholics who use it to justify images.
teachings.text:
Here in chapter 18, we begin to learn of King Hezekiah, son of Ahaz, king of Judah. *And he* *did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that David his father did.*

He not only did that which was right, but broke down the high places and the images, and cut down the groves where the heathen worshiped. He even destroyed the brazen serpent, called Nehushtan, which Moses had made when the fiery serpents were killing the children of Israel in their camp in the wilderness.

**Numbers 21:8-9**
*And the LORD said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live. And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.*

This was, of course, a picture of Christ.

**John 3:14-15**
*And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.*

While Nehushtan's original purpose was to serve as a picture of Christ, showing that the children of Israel looked to it and lived, just as we look to Christ lifted up on the cross and have eternal life, the brazen serpent was never itself meant to be an object of worship. Men weren't to bow and serve it. It had a specific purpose, and that purpose was past.

Catholics and their schismatics in other denominations, use the brazen serpent to justify their idolatry. They say that if God told Moses to make this particular image, then the making of any image is allowed. And they proceed to bow and serve them, lighting candles and incense to them, and pray at their feet.

They seldom have ever heard of Nehushtan. They don't know the story of Hezekiah. They don't know he destroyed it because the children of Israel were treating it the way Catholics treat images of the crucifix, of Mary and various other humans.

That the word of God says Hezekiah did that which was right in the eyes of the Lord and destroyed it. They err not knowing scripture, determined to keep their groves and high places and their images they make. To worship outside of the ways God had given in His word. Keeping to vain traditions and dead works.

teachings.title: Elisha's bones and the cult of relics
teachings.summary: One verse about Elisha's bones is twisted by Orthodox and Roman churches to justify relic worship, which scripture calls unclean, showing why doctrine must come only from clear scripture compared with scripture.
teachings.text:
Elisha's death occurs in this chapter, and a miracle concerning the prophet; Moabites invade and while burying a man, they spied a band coming, a s so they cast the dead man into the sepulchre of Elisha, and when he was lowered into the tomb, he touched the prophet's bones and revived.

This one short verse is used, primarily by the Orthodox Church, but by many Roman Catholics as well, to justify their veneration and worship of corpses, skulls and bones. Relics, they say, of "holy men," the "saints." They claim the bones have power, that there is Spirit still invested in them, and that this power can be transferred to those that touch them, pray to them, and worship them in rites and rituals.

This pagan cult of relics, worshiping death, serving the dead things of the flesh, is wicked as Hell. As Proverbs says; *all they that hate me love death.*

They store the skeletal remains, usually of unknown origin but with grandiose claims or being Apostles, certain saints, in special places. Temples of death. In glass cases to be paraded about, being served. Miracles are attributed to these abominations. Forgeries abound.

But Scripture gives no such accounting. A miracle occurred. The how and the why aren't given. Elisha isn't exhumed and carted around to temples. No Israelites lined up to seek to be healed by the relics of a finger bone or skull.

No instruction is given by the inspiration of God to do anything of the sort. In fact, we are told repeatedly by the word of God that to do so is unclean. It's gross.

**Numbers 19:13**
*Whosoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel*; *because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.*

Most of the profane and false doctrines of Rome that have trickled down to the various offshoots of that false church, come from similarly dubious reasoning, where they take a single verse or incident, remove whatever context exists in scripture, and make assumptions and assertions that rely on the foolish reasoning of man, rather than the clear word of God.

This is why we as saved Christians should only take doctrine from clear, undeniable scripture. Proving all things. Comparing spiritual things with spiritual things. Searching the scriptures to see if something is so.

teachings.title: His way or nothing
teachings.summary: Jehoram removed Baal but kept Jeroboam's false worship in God's name, like Roman Catholicism mixing paganism with the Lord, and worship done man's way is evil in God's sight.
teachings.text:
And so Jehoram, son of Ahab reigned over Israel and he put away the idols of Baal that his father and Jezebel worshipped, but he kept the false religion established by Jeroboam.

It isn't enough to rid yourself of false gods. It isn't enough to turn from the idols of this world and the blasphemous images and wicked things that are obviously against God.

Jehoram did the right thing but he kept the false religion that claimed to be of the God of Israel. Just as the golden calf of Aaron was said to be the same god that carried them out of Egypt, Jeroboam made like images and said they represented the same gods.

Aaron called the children of Israel to a feast for the Lord in front of the calf, where they worshiped and offered sacrifices. Jeroboam created feasts to the Lord and idols to be worshipped in His name and sacrifices made by the priesthood he'd created to serve him.

They mixed paganism with the Lord and it was an abomination to God. The word tells us how He wants it to be and by doing this, these leaders caused the people of God to sin.

And both Aaron and Jeroboam did it for political reasons. To maintain power and control over a stiff-necked and rebellious people.

The false apostate church of Roman Catholicism is the same. They created their own idols, feast days, religious practices, rites and sacraments, instituted their own priesthood, sacrifice to idols they tell their followers represent God. Offering sacrifice to them.

They have the appearance of righteousness but are still evil in His sight.

This is why the push by Catholicism to establish a "Christian Nationalist" fervor in America as an answer to the wickedness of the godless sodomites and Jews is so appealing to so many.

But we see over and over again in God's word that it isn't enough to say you are worshiping God when you are doing it your way. Man's way.

It is His way or nothing.

teachings.title: Solomon said nay: no queen mediatrix
teachings.summary: Rome twists Bathsheba's petition to make Mary a queen mediatrix, but Solomon refused her and there is one mediator between God and man, Christ Jesus.
teachings.text:
Now Adonijah, who had been spared after he bent the knee to Solomon comes to the King's mother, Bathsheba, with a request. He asks for Abishag a Shunammite to be his wife. In 1 Kings 1 we are told that the sick and dying David took young and fair Abishag to lay with him for warmth. And although they never consummated their relationship, she was as a concubine to the King.

Adonijah asks Bathsheba saying that because of her relationship with Solomon, the king couldn't refuse her. Perhaps flattered, Bathsheba does as he asks and approaches the king, and is even given honor of sitting at his right hand, and she asks this thing for the half-brother of Solomon.

Solomon, in his wisdom, recognizes what this entails, for an elder son to take for wife the concubine of the former king, solidifying Adonijah's false claim to the throne. Solomon correctly ignores his mother's petition and orders the upstart's death.

Roman Catholicism will sometimes point to a truncated version of this story to paint a picture of Mary as "queen" and mediatrix between man and Christ Jesus. They will include the flattery of Adonijah, saying "*for he will not say thee nay*" anything Mary asks of Him. As if this were some sort of cheat code to get around the will of God by appealing to the mother of Christ.

They will say that Solomon's response to his mother is the same response of Jesus to Mary, "*Ask on, my mother: for I will not say thee nay.*"

They will ignore that Solomon not only said nay, but had Adonijah killed for his attempt to make an end run around the anointed of the Lord.

There is one mediator between God and man. The man Christ Jesus.

teachings.title: To obey is better than sacrifice
teachings.summary: False religion offers its own righteousness and costly works instead of believing on Christ's righteousness, which God calls rebellion and witchcraft.
teachings.text:
*Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.*

This is so hard for people trapped in false religion to grasp. They believe their own righteousness must be offered in sacrifice, even if it means going against the command of God to believe on His Son's righteousness instead.

They will dress it up as Saul did. That they are offering the best. Buildings made of marble and images laid with gold, and sacrifices made to idols representing, in their minds, Christ. Doing all these works that they reasoned for themselves as good. That their logic of men and vain traditions came up with, often through compromise and fear of the people.

God despises it. It is witchcraft. Rebellion.

teachings.title: Israel wanted a king they could see
teachings.summary: Like Israel demanding a visible king, natural men in false churches want idols, rites and a man as head of the church rather than faith in the unseen promise of God.
teachings.text:
And so Samuel established King Saul before the people of Israel. Having confirmed their trust and confidence in his honesty, Samuel reproaches them yet again, that while God has not failed to deliver His people again and again, this time at the threat of the Ammonites they demanded instead a king.

God harkened to them, and appointed a king over them, because they rejected having God be their King.

Having the uncertainty of salvation, lacking trust in the spiritual things of God, they sought to be as the world was. To have a physical king over them that they could see and understand and to be like other nations.

In the same way many professing Christians reject evidence that is unseen, the promise of God and eternal life in Christ, the sealing of the Spirit. They want physical representations; idols to pray to, rituals and rites to participate in, a man on earth to be head over their church. They seek the reassurance of the carnal over the word of God. They are natural men.

**Hebrews 11:1-3**
*Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen. For by it the elders obtained a good report. Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.*

**1 Corinthians 2:14**
*But the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God: for they are foolishness unto him: neither can he know them, because they are spiritually discerned.*

This lack of faith in God to deliver us from our sin as He has promised and demonstrated time and again is a seed that leads to destruction.

teachings.title: Golden emerods and apostate superstitions
teachings.summary: Like the Philistines' made-up trespass offering, apostate churches acknowledge the true God but invent rites, sacraments and superstitions that are as profane to Him.
teachings.text:
Now, of course the jewels of gold the Philistines used as their trespass offering is not what the Lord had established. While He had handed down specifics to Moses for a trespass offering which may not be known to these heathen priests, the knowledge of the offerings acceptable unto God was with man since Abel.

But absent the word and not having an understanding of the spiritual things of God, they just made things up like the golden emerods and mice. Superstitiously sending the unguided cart out from them on the hopes it was near happenstance that the plague fell upon them. Seeking a sign from their own understanding.

Ironically, they had the word of God present before them inside the ark that carried the tablets of Moses.

They had the right God, the understanding of who He was, and His power, even acknowledging His power over the idols they worshipped. But with all that they still had no idea how to please Him, not having faith in His word.

In much the same way we see how apostate churches, filled with idols and a priesthood that lacks understanding, makes up foolish rituals and rites, seeking after superstitious signs, despite acknowledging the true God, even the Son and holy Spirit.

They invent sacraments, meat and drink offerings to idols, rites and practices like blessing against choking on fishbones by holding unlit candles to their throats, wearing scapulas of leather and prayer beads for luck. Burying images of men upside down to sell property. Calling upon spirits of house gods to find their lost items. Wishing upon these same spirits to bring them fortune.

All of these vain traditions of men are as profane and offensive as the idea of casting golden images of a hemorrhoid and offering it to the Lord.

teachings.title: Dagon fallen before the ark
teachings.summary: The fall of Dagon before the ark shows God curses any attempt to mix His word and testament with idolatry, as Rome does.
teachings.text:
The Philistines take the Ark to their temple for Dagon, the fish god, and place the box containing the tablets of the covenant, the word of God, beside the image of Dagon.

When they come the following day, their idol is laying face down towards the Ark. They right the graven image made with human hands, and the following day it is not only knocked over, but its hands and head are cut off. A useless idol, decapitated.

What happens when a false religion attempts to mix the promise of God with idols made of wood or stone? In temples made by hand?

It has been suggested that the mitre and cope of a Catholic bishop resembles the clerical garments of the priests of Dagon, that they are a continuation of the cult of the Philistines. Now that may just be part of sectarian propaganda between the whore of Rome and its harlot daughters, but the truth is that here in **1 Samuel 5**, we see a humiliating picture of what God thinks of mixing the promise of His word and idolatry. That those who go against God and try to join His testament that we have faith in, to a graven image plated with gold, are cursed.

The priests of Dagon refused to even venture back into the temple they made for it for fear, even to the day of the writing of 1st Samuel, hundreds of years later.

teachings.title: Micah's house of gods and the Danites' apostate priest
teachings.summary: Dan conquered Laish with Micah's stolen idols and a hired Levite priest, sowing its own downfall into captivity, a picture of Rome's idols, images and unqualified priesthood that God will judge.
teachings.text:
**Joshua 19:47**
*And the coast of the children of Dan went out too little for them: therefore the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and dwelt therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.*

**Judges 17-18** tells the story of Micah, his creation of his own church full of idols and icons, an ephod and teraphim, and his recruiting of a young Levite to be his personal house priest, calling him "father."

In those days there was no king in Israel. And men did as seemed right in their own eyes.

The story presented occurs during the period immediately after Joshua's death, where Dan had not fully gone out to take their inheritance from those that dwelled there.

**Joshua 23:4-5**
*Behold, I have divided unto you by lot these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even unto the great sea westward. And the LORD your God, he shall expel them from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and ye shall possess their land, as the LORD your God hath promised unto you.*

Joshua had waxed old and died before the tribes had finished the work to go out and possess the land given them. Dan especially was shown to be dragging behind the other tribes.

And here they are seeking to go out and find land to take. In **Judges 18**, we find that the troop of spies stop at Mt Ephraim, and lodge at the house of Micah. There they recognized the young Levite, and inquire why he's there. He tells them of the arrangements made with Micah, his hire and role as a private priest over a house of gods.

They ask him for God's blessings in finding a suitable city to take, and he says reassuring words that God had blessed their endeavors. And so, 600 Danites set forth to go into the land, armed for war.

They come up on the house of Micah and the spies tell their army about the gods and the silver graven image and the ephod and priest, and they go in and take all the idols and ephod for themselves. The priest protests and they tell him to come with them and be their priest, and he agrees.

Micah seeing this runs out with some men from his town and Micah confronts them. The much larger force of men gathered for war tell him to stop, or he may forfeit his and his family's lives.

And so Dan finds the city of Laish, or Leshem, and the people there living simple and peaceful lives, and take it for themselves, renaming the city Dan.

And the young priest of the Levites turns out to be the son of Gershom, he and his sons, with their stolen idols and icons and fake Ephod, become the priests for the tribe of Dan until the captivity of the land. The seeds of their own downfall sown by rejecting the way of the Lord and turning to idols.

A people can seem mighty, and put many simple peasants to the sword while carrying the banner of conquest, and relying on idols and images. Unqualified priests. But in the end, God will judge them and their abominations.

Danites went marching on a crusade with their apostate priest and easily took the land, but lost their understanding. The parallel with Roman Catholics should be obvious. The end of those people being captivity and destruction, if they don't turn from Idolatry, repenting towards the Lord.

teachings.title: Micah's house of gods
teachings.summary: Micah, zealous but not after knowledge, built his own church of images with a priest called father, against God's word.
teachings.text:
Micah, doing what seems good in his eyes, thinking in some way he is following the Lord, has sought to establish his own religion, his own church, even as the Tabernacle is in Shiloh.

His family appears to be wealthy, his mother's riches and her spoiling of her son, catering to his whims even after his theft is revealed, shows that in many ways, Micah is blessed. Born into a peaceful area, with silver enough to make idols, and even to hire a priest to legitimize his endeavor. Naturally, not knowing better, having a zeal for the Lord but not after knowledge, Micah believes his efforts are blessed of the Lord. He thinks by his accumulating idols and images, an ephod and teraphims, and even a genuine Levite to be his priest, to call "father," that the Lord will do him good.

Micah creates a building full of gods, a priest called "father." A place of worship to the Lord that violates the commands set forth by the word of God, because it seemed right in his own eyes.

teachings.title: Divination and Moloch an abomination
teachings.summary: He teaches that child sacrifice like abortion, divination, astrology and mediums are abominations, practitioners being both frauds and conduits for Satan.
teachings.text:
The laws of the Levitical priesthood, clarified for this post-wandering world the children of Israel are about to enter. Another warning that they have not a physical inheritance, but rather in service to the people, ministering to them of God. Fed by their offerings.

Then, another warning against taking up the heathen practices of the people before them, who were driven out of the land for their abominations.

Not to allow those who sacrifice their children to Moloch, who passed them through the fire. Who, seeking fortune and prosperity kill their own children. Just as the abortionists practice today.

Not to allow those who practice divination, astrology, hypnotism and enchantments, potions and hexes and curses. Mediums and those that speak to spirits, or the dead. Or who claim to perform magic.

All that do these things are an abomination to the Lord.

The Bible makes clear that these false teachers and sorcerers are both preying on superstitious nonsense in service to gods made of mans hands. Of their own invention. Who have no the power to do anything at all. And they serve the devil and are easily influenced by evil spirits, used to snare and offend the unregenerate. They feed on false hope, *and* are a conduit for Satan. It's both, and equally wicked.

teachings.title: Any host of heaven, including the saints
teachings.summary: He teaches the ban on worshipping any host of heaven includes the Catholic saints, and that a blemished sacrifice pictures halfway believers who never truly trust Christ.
teachings.text:
The start of the chapter is continuing the thought that started in 16, on the sacrifices and honoring the place God would choose to place His name, as well as the punishment of those that chased after false gods, even the sun, moon or any host of Heaven, which God had not commanded. That is ANY host of Heaven, including the "saints" that Catholics worship. God has not commanded them to do it, and yet they have taken up this form of idolatry and pagan superstition anyway.

In a nation of believers, such would be put to death by the all the people under 2 or 3 witnesses, and they as witnesses would have to pick up the first stones.

This would prevent the abuse of such a law, while ensuring the veracity of the witnesses. Who could testify falsely unto death and be evil enough to cast the first stone? Yet alone two or three in league with each other?

God calls this form of false religion an abomination. He has not changed His view.

Of course the sacrifice being without blemish is a picture of Christ, but also an admonition against offering a sacrifice of convenience, ridding the herd of defects rather than offering the best to God. This also pictures the half-way saved "believers," who never commit to faith, who believe in vain, understanding the terms of the gospel but never actually trusting it in their hearts, but instead going through the motions for convenience sake. Many churches have people like this, tares among them. People who go, sing, take part but never really give their best, just marking time.

God wants us to be all the way in. He doesn't want us offering our worst, because He offered the best, His Son Christ Jesus.

teachings.title: God hates your images
teachings.summary: He teaches God hates any image set up for worship, with no allowance for intention or veneration, and that Catholic and Orthodox icons bring His judgment.
teachings.text:
*Thou shalt not plant thee a grove of any trees near unto the altar of the Lord thy God, which thou shalt make thee. Neither shalt thou set thee up any image; which the Lord thy God hateth.*

This warning again, as was so frequently given in previous chapters, against the planting of groves for worship around the altar that will be set up, is to avoid it falling away over time to the practices of the heathen. The pagan Canaanites driven from the land. But as we see throughout the pagan world, worship of trees and graven images, the Idolatry of the unbelieving who worship the created more than the Creator who is blessed forever, amen, seems to be the default religion of fallen man. It doesn't bring blessings. It doesn't bring gratitude and gifts of the calling. It doesn't bring right judgment. It brings wickedness of the reprobate mind.

God could not be clearer; Do not set up an image to bow and serve. God HATES idols. The Lord hates the setting up of an image for worship.

Note he doesn't say "of false gods." There are no caveats given. Yes, His concern is that over time they will be worshipped in the flesh rather than kept in the Spirit. But He is firm that He hates them entirely.

Catholics and Orthodox who have set up idols, graven images and icons, God hates them.

God hates them.

This can't be ignored or rationalized away. It isn't "different when we do it." God doesn't make an allowance for your sincerity or your zeal. He doesn't care about your intentions, or the fig leaf of "veneration." God hates your images.

And the worship of those graven images, regardless of who you believe they portray, brings harsh judgement upon the people who kneel before them in prayer. Who light candles and incense to them. Who hold vigils and pray in vain repetitions before them.

*Neither shalt thou set thee up any image; which the Lord thy God hateth.*

teachings.title: Ye shall not do so unto the Lord
teachings.summary: God forbade Israel to worship Him with the pagans' images and high places, which he says plainly repudiates Catholic use of icons and idols.
teachings.text:
**Deuteronomy 12** continues the preface to the retelling of the law to the generation that will be given the promised land. That they live long in the land and it be well with them.

*Ye shall utterly destroy all the places, wherein the nations which ye shall possess served their gods, upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and under every green tree: And ye shall overthrow their altars, and break their pillars, and burn their groves with fire; and ye shall hew down the graven images of their gods, and destroy the names of them out of that place. Ye shall not do so unto the Lord your God.*

The Lord again admonishes them to utterly destroy the religious sites of the Canaanites. To smash their idols and tear down their groves, to destroy the names of their gods forever, so that they do not commit adultery, whoredoms. That they do not chase after idols and false gods as the people who came before them. Remembering the first and second commandments.

It's also important to note that God tells them not to worship Him in the same manner. Not to bow before and serve idols, or offer sacrifices on their hewn altars in the high places. Not to adopt the ways of the pagans before them. This repudiation of Catholic dogma regarding icons and idols, the amalgam of Roman paganism and Christianity, is so clearly taught throughout the Bible, but especially here. *Ye shall not do so unto the Lord your God.*

teachings.title: The second commandment against Rome's idols
teachings.summary: He teaches that bowing, praying, lighting candles and holding vigils before idols and icons in the Roman church is worship and blasphemy forbidden by the second commandment.
teachings.text:
Moses continues the second telling of the law, and so **Deuteronomy 5** contains a second recitation of the 10 Commandments, reminding the people of the covenant made with them at Mt Horeb, also known as **Sinai**. This covenant came from the living God directly to the people, speaking to them from a fire that covered the mountain with His glory, saying:

*I am the Lord thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage. Thou shalt have none other gods before me.*

This first command holds true to us today, having been delivered out of bondage by the grace of God through faith in the Lord Jesus Christ. Set at liberty from the bondage of the law, and being servants to sin.

*Thou shalt not make thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the waters beneath the earth: Thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me*...

There is no amount of cope and vain imagining that can excuse the use of idols and icons in the false churches of the Roman cult. None. The second commandment of God couldn't be clearer. "We don't worship them!" Bowing before, kneeling, praying to and serving these idols, is worship. Lighting candles, incense, decking them with flowers and crowns, holding vigils to them and feasts...these are all blasphemy. And God warns that he will visit evil on the people who do this to the 4th generation, because this inequity comes from hatred of God. But we who love Him and keep these commands are blessed by His mercy.

teachings.title: No similitude: flee idols
teachings.summary: God showed no form at Horeb, so any image or veneration in worship is idolatry, which Rome hides by removing the second commandment.
teachings.text:
Moses in the Spirit, recounts when they assembled and heard the voice of the Lord God in Horeb, and witnessed His power there in the giving of the law. And he uses this to reinforce the second commandment, as the reminder of the destruction at *Baalpeor* reminded them of the first. How the people were destroyed for seeking another god to put before them. Now Moses warns against serving idols, graven images, bowing before them.

He reminds them that "*the Lord spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only ye heard a voice*." There is no image or idol or any physical representation of God that appeared unto them. Just glory and might and power, and His word, like thunder.

*Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day that the Lord spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire: Lest ye corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female, The likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air, The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth*.

The command against idols and graven images in worship is clear; and God considers is an abomination. He knows the wicked hearts of men would turn to giving His glory to the created rather than to the Creator. The vanity of men over the power of the Living God. He even warns against the worship of nature; *lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them*.

There is no physical or carnal worship in the religion of God. Not of idols made by superstitious man. Not in the physical creation we can observe. Because we must come to Him in faith, for without faith it is impossible to please Him.

The Bible says *faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen*, so by the very definition, a physical representation of the living God or anything in creation be it man or woman or beast or celestial body, is anathema.

Idolatry is wicked. There is no excuse given for "veneration," or honoring saints, or to be used as "focus for prayer" or any other thing.

Catholicism hates this commandment of God so much that they remove the prohibition against Idolatry from the list of the 10 Commandments, relegating it to a watered down subsection of the 1st, and splitting up the command against covetousness to maintain their deceitful decade.

Flee idols.

teachings.title: Nehushtan: no license for idolatry
teachings.summary: The brazen serpent was a picture of Christ, not an object of worship, and Hezekiah destroyed it when Israel burned incense to it, as crucifixes are worshipped today.
teachings.text:
**2 Kings 18**
*Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, that Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.*

*2 Twenty and five years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Abi, the daughter of Zachariah.*

*3 And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that David his father did.*

*4 He removed the high places, and brake the images, and cut down the groves, and brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made: for unto those days the children of Israel did burn incense to it: and he called it Nehushtan.*

*5 He trusted in the Lord God of Israel; so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah, nor any that were before him.*
