*6 For he clave to the Lord, and departed not from following him, but kept his commandments, which the Lord commanded Moses.*

Just to add this postscript to the study on **Numbers 2**, this chapter and the story of the brazen serpent, is often cited by Catholics and Orthodox to justify their wicked pagan Idolatry.

To a man, those who have brought it up to me don't know or ever heard of "Nehushtan." Nehushtan means a thing of bronze, and it was not meant to be prayed to, to be bowed before or served. It wasn't meant to have incense burned to it, or candles lit in devotion. It has a singular purpose and it was to serve as a picture of Christ, who was lifted up on the cross, and became sin that we may look to Him and live.

Hezekiah, who did what was right in the sight of the Lord destroyed idols and temples and high places of the false gods, and he brake apart the brazen serpent. It was being worshipped in the same way crucifixes are in these apostate churches today. A picture for our benefit to understand the concept of salvation and eternal life in Christ, whose literal purpose was simply to heal Israelites bitten by the fiery snakes God had sent among them.

The physical application and spiritual are given us. And it is not a license to Idolatry.

teachings.title: Thou shalt not bow down to graven images
teachings.summary: Idolatry is still sin, and Catholic kneeling, candles and processions before images are worship of idols, a key reason God's wrath is on America and Europe.
teachings.text:
Just a side note, the New Testament commands we flew idols. That Idolatry is still a sin. *Ye shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold* still stands.

*Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth. Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me.*

Note also, that this commandment, which Catholics omit from their version, for obvious reasons, has 'bowing down,' the literal meaning of worship. Those kneeling before idols are worshiping. Those lighting a candle in front of them are serving. The feasts of the "saints," where the people carry an idol through the streets, and give service unto it are a blasphemy.

And God promises to strike a nation, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon them unto the third and fourth generation.

If you want to know one of the prime reasons God's wrath is upon the United States, and Europe, it is for allowing this blasphemy to continue for 1500yrs.

teachings.title: The rosary is pagan vain repetition
teachings.summary: The rosary is of pagan origin and its repetitive prayers break Jesus' command against vain repetitions.
teachings.text:
The "Rosary" is a pagan blasphemy that requires vain, repetitive prayers. Ten times as many to a human, Mary, than to the purported "God" being prayed to.

The earliest reference to a rosary (boberkhas) is in their "Jain Canon" (456 AD) These boberkhas had various numbers of beads 6,9,12,18,36 (any sub-multiple of Kabbalah's 108). Islam (610 AD) uses a rosary of 99 beads, one for each of the names of God. Buddhists have 108 prayer beads on their string. The Rosary is of pagan origin and no Christian prior to 1000 AD used beads to pray.

Jesus forbids repetitive prayer in **Matthew 6:7-8**

*But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.*
*Be not ye therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him*.

Another vain tradition of men that scripture explicitly commands against.

teachings.title: Rome edited the second commandment
teachings.summary: Rome removed the commandment against graven images and split the tenth, so its use of idols breaks God's law.
teachings.text:
A Catholic "Pope" ordered the 2nd of the 10 commandments be edited, so they could use idols, statues & images in worship. They split the 10th commandment on coveting into two commandments so they could still have 10 in number.

 Don't believe this? Look at the list of 10 commandments published by the Roman Catholic church! Their list of Commandments published to this day do not include the words from **Exodus 20:3-5**

*Thou shalt have no other gods before me. Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth. Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me.*

To worship idols or graven images of anyone or anything is to despise God and breaks His commandment, visiting the inequalities of these heathens on to their 3rd and 4th generation.

Our God is a jealous God. Amen!

teachings.title: Who is my mother, or my brethren?
teachings.summary: Mark 3 shows Mary had other children and that Jesus did not exalt her above any believer, so Marian veneration before images is blasphemy and idolatry.
teachings.text:
The chapter closes out with an exchange that Catholics hate to hear; Jesus' mother Mary, and his half siblings down from Nazareth to check on Jesus thinking him "beside himself", or crazy in other words.

This and the parallel passages in the other Gospels recounting the incident show that Jesus was the first born of a virgin, Mary, but that she and Joseph had other children together and so she was not some sort of perpetual virgin. This is extra biblical nonsense, and part of a cult that worships a false goddess called the Queen of Heaven.

Further it shows that Jesus didn't venerate his mother over anyone else who believed. God is not a respecter of persons. We are called to love Jesus more than our own mothers and fathers, sisters and brothers. And to love our fellow believers as brothers.

*Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.*

*And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren? And he looked round about on them which sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren! For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.*

We who are saved, who are heirs to the kingdom of heaven, are adopted sons of God. The Bible says Jesus is not ashamed to call us brethren. We are a Holy Family.

And while at least two of Jesus's half Brothers and his mother Mary, were saved by faith and joint heirs with us, and given glory in heaven for their work for the Lord, they aren't of the same status and stature as God himself. They are not meant to be treated as anything more than a fellow believer. And this example in Jesus's life exemplifies this principle.

Worshiping, that is kneeling in prayer and praise, before statues, graven images made of Stone and metal and wood, to call upon the names of man to petition God our Father, is one of the greatest blasphemies short of blaspheming the Holy Ghost.

There is no biblical instruction that justifies this false doctrine, and there are examples such as this, that clearly show the proper relationship between Christ and us as believers, and his earthly blood relatives in Mary.

The logic of man that justifies this blasphemy is undone by the wisdom of God. If you want to honor the mother of Christ on earth, then be as Jesus's mother and sisters and brothers, believing on Him for salvation alone.

teachings.title: Professors who bury the talent
teachings.summary: God's indictment in Psalm 50 is against false professors who bury His gift and think formal worship spares them from wrath, while His righteous are protected.
teachings.text:
To whom much is given much is expected. There are professing Christians in this world who have never accepted the gift that God has extended to us. They've taken the offer and buried it and done nothing with it. They didn't take it in as their own and nurture it and use it to increase God's kingdom.

Again this isn't a works-based salvation. If the unprofitable servant had taken his one talent of silver and kept it in his care, he'd still have been saved. But rather he buried it, and went through the motions.

God goes out of his way in his indictment against Israel in **Psalm 50** to stipulate that His people who are righteous are protected under his care. His problem is with the false professors of His name who think that the formalism of their worship is sufficient to spare them from His wrath.

teachings.title: Whited tombs: church as a checkbox
teachings.summary: Those who treat church and ritual as proof of holiness are whited tombs; we assemble to exhort one another and stay salty, praising God until Christ comes.
teachings.text:
God's accusations against them are sharp. They can tend with thieves and are partakers with adulterers. Both the literal engagement with the worldly, and the spiritual, of general ecumenicalism. They speak evil things, and lie. They not only don't love their neighbors, but they lie against their own brothers.

And God, God who is longsuffering and merciful and wood that all men come to repentance, gave them space and time to reconsider their ways. Instead they considered themselves holy, like God is Holy. They thought that in their religious practices, and keeping the letter of the law that they could ignore the purpose of the law and its spirit.

It's the same indictment here as in **Matthew 23**. And it could be said Of so many supposed Christians today.

It's interesting to me that **Hebrews 10** bookends the idea of being no more need for sacrifice for those in Christ, and there being no more sacrifice for willful sin, around the command to attend church.

**Hebrews 10:23–25**
*Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;) And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.*

We are commanded to not forsake the assembly. And the purpose of that is to love one another. Edifying each other. Building each other up. So much more as the day approaches.

But today, there are those who see church as a check box for their righteousness. Proving that they are holy as God is holy simply by their attendance. And in so many acts that they do, they wash the outside of the vessel, while inside they are whited tombs filled with dead men's bones.

Those people to whom religion is a series of rituals and obligations that only benefit themselves, who see sacraments as their sacrifice rather than the blood of Christ. Christians in name only who go through the motions and never once consider God.

They forget God and he will tear them to pieces. They bury their talent out of fear, while never truly fearing God.

But God, ever gracious ends on a positive note.

*Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God.*

Our purpose of being his people is to praise his name that he be glorified among men. We are the salt of the earth. We are what is preserving the world against judgment. And so he's encouraging us to continue in that praise and thanksgiving and glorifying God among men.

Because it is possible for salt to lose its savor. For lukewarm Christians to have the candle of their church put out. To be of no further use of God so he calls you home if you're saved and if you're not, casting you into outer darkness.

**Matthew 5:13**
*Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.*

God's case against Israel is God's case against all who call themselves by His name and fail to live to proclaim His glory.

Let us then stay salty, maintain our savor, do all things with Mercy and judgment forgiving those who trespass against us, considering the plight of the poor and the widow and the fatherless. Exhorting one another.

So that at the coming of Christ, when He brings fiery judgment upon the world, We will be found acceptable. Where He will say that we are good and faithful servants. Amen

teachings.title: Repent of sins teachers are least forgiving
teachings.summary: He observes that churches teaching repentance of sin as a condition of salvation become self-righteous and unforgiving, having lost grace and humility.
teachings.text:
As an aside, in my experience, churches and people who teach repentance of sin as a condition of salvation tend to be the least forgiving.

They take pride and hope in their own righteousness, and need to compare themselves to the sins of others so that they can make themselves feel holier. This is the sin of self-righteousness. Something that used to be widely understood in Christian circles. But with the rise of things like lordship salvation and repent of your sins heresy that grace and mercy and humility has gone out the window in many congregations today. They become respecters of persons. They give themselves some credit for being freed from bondage in Egypt rather than understanding, it was by the grace and mercy of God.

Something to keep in mind

teachings.title: Judaizers bringing the free back into bondage
teachings.summary: As Judah took back the servants they had freed, false teachers and works salvationists seek to bring those set at liberty in Christ back under the yoke of the law and the traditions of men.
teachings.text:
Just as the Jews of Jeremiah's day, there are Judaizers, who seek to turn those the Lord has sought to set at liberty, to return and be brought into subjection, to be servants and handmaids. To return to bondage.

Literally, during this siege of Judah. Spiritually now, in the time of the reformation, whereby we are set free, at liberty in Christ.

And God witnesses this and promises their swift destruction.

**2 Peter 2:1**
*But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.*

Just as God slew and put in chains the people of Judah who refused to allow their servants the liberty their lord commanded, even while beset by armies and with the preaching of destruction in their ears, they couldn't let go of the power they had over brethren. So too, false teachers knowing the judgment of God and the fires of Hell that will await them, cannot help but try and bring those set at liberty back under their thumb.

Ultimately, works salvationists are seeking to control people. To be the arbiter of their freedoms. To decide who, in their carnal mind, is worthy or righteous, so that they can condemn everyone who follows them. It's wicked as Hell.

And the works of the law, commandments of men and vain traditions they seek to yoke people to is not of God, who would that all men be free in Christ.

teachings.title: Lordship salvation is a false gospel
teachings.summary: Requiring people to make Jesus Lord of their life or repent of their sins to be saved makes man his own savior and is another gospel.
teachings.text:
Lordship salvation is a false doctrine, put forth by vipers that say you have to "make Jesus the Lord of your life," or "boss of your life," in order to be saved. That you have to "repent of your sins" and try to "avoid sin," or you cannot be saved.

This is wicked as Hell.

To be saved we must understand that we are sinners and incapable of justifying ourselves to God. This is only part of accepting salvation, and part of Biblical repentance that is taught in nearly all independent fundamentalist Baptist churches. It is a part of the truth we must believe to actually trust on Christ for our salvation.

But the idea that our salvation rests in any way with our ability to turn from sin makes the person their own savior, robs the glory of God, and puts Christ to an open shame.

People who are giving a false gospel that includes "turning from your sin" or making Jesus the "boss of your life," are false teachers and are bringing another gospel.

Jesus is Lord, and God sits on His throne whether you believe or not. Whether you backslide or whether you go soul winning and Bible reading daily and attending church 3 times a week.

The humility and humbling of ourselves comes from the recognition that we are sinners, deserving death and Hell. Our salvation is in accepting that Jesus died for us, and we are washed clean in the blood. Not in how well we strive to live a perfect sinless life.

teachings.title: By their fruits: works-based false prophets
teachings.summary: By their fruits ye shall know them is about false prophets, whose works-based gospel produces insecure, legalistic, hypocritical followers.
teachings.text:
Ultimately, works-based false religion is about pride, and those who push this evil rely on that pride as a way to snare the unsuspecting into their false religion, and away from the truth of God.

It allows them to teach as commandments traditions of men. It allows them to dictate others' "salvation," by letting them set the standard one must reach. It is the root of every false religion.

And you can judge them by their fruit.

**Matthew 7:15-20**
*Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.*
*Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles? Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit. A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit. Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire. Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.*

This is the context of "by their fruits ye shall know them." It isn't about judging someone's salvation, but judging a false prophet. The fruit are those acolytes they gather to themselves.

Works-based "repent of your sins" false prophets create proselytes unsure of their salvation, constantly looking for measures and signs that they are, rather than faith in trusting God's word. And because we all fall short of the glory of God, they begin to be legalistic and holier than thou, seeking to make another man's behavior the mark they have to be better than, that they may look down upon them. It creates hypocrisy and respect of persons. They produce thorns and thistles. Not fruit meet for repentance.

teachings.title: What must I do to be saved
teachings.summary: Answering a seeker with repent of your sins instead of believe on the Lord Jesus Christ only leads to confusion, discouragement and perdition.
teachings.text:
And imagine being an unsaved but seeking person, desperate to know what they must do to be saved, like the Philippian jailer, and you ask "Sirs, what must I do to be saved?"

And the answer isn't "Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ," but instead is "well, you have to repent of your sins."

"What does that mean? Like stop sinning? What if I can't? Which sins? The really bad ones? What if I don't realize it's a sin? What if I slip up?"

"Well, try to avoid sin. You have to want to avoid sin."

"How? I can't be saved if I don't try to avoid sin? I already am trying not to drink/smoke/watch porn. Is that good enough? How will I know if it's good enough? If I'm good enough?"

"Well then make Jesus your boss. Make him the Lord of your life."

"Isn't He already? What does that even mean? Do I have to sell everything and follow Him like the young rich man?"

Etc...

It is not a Gospel presentation. It's an invitation to confusion, discouragement and perdition.

teachings.title: Zeal of God, but not according to knowledge
teachings.summary: Professing Christians who insist on being special, like the unbelieving Jews, go about to establish their own righteousness and become zealots for a works system.
teachings.text:
*For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge. For they being ignorant of God's righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.*

This one verse is possibly the most significant when I'm trying to understand a person who professes to be a christian and yet persists and being a special boy.

Just as Paul wrote about the Jews after the flesh of whom, he was counted being of the tribe of Benjamin, That's what these people are.

The Jews believe they were special boys and have the kingdom of God taken from them. And they become zealots about their religion and their perverted worship of God. Their gospel becomes the rationalizations for their heresy. They'll defend it at all costs. Even as they deny the Gospel which they rejected.

Their entire identity becomes invested in defending the scene they belong to rather than preaching the cross to others. Or edifying the brothers.

And they have to be zealots because they aren't saved. They don't believe in eternal life. Don't believe in being sealed by the spirit unto the day of redemption. They believe that salvation is doled out. Given piecemeal through the church. So they're stuck in bondage to whatever works system or ridiculous heresy they're asked to follow.

This is the main problem with most of them. There are others who believe in becoming worthy by repenting of their sin or making Jesus the Lord of their life. They become zealous of it and in truth they're hypocrites.

These are different flavors of special boys

teachings.title: Abstaining from meats: a sign of false religion
teachings.summary: Imposing meat bans or Levitical dietary laws, whether Catholic or Judaizing, is a doctrine of devils and a red flag of a cult.
teachings.text:
There are some false religions that impose carnal ordinances of abstaining from types of meats to be "holy," what the Bible calls "doctrines of devils."

This applies not only to the Catholic practices of not eating meat on Fridays, which we see is totally foolish and unbiblical, but more and more in Judaized Evangelical circles, the imposition of Levitical dietary laws.

But we who are saved in Christ know that nothing is unclean if it is eaten in thanksgiving, blessed by God.

This provides a simple test for the believer to see if they are involved in a cult or false religion. Any implementation of the Old Testament ordinances done away with in the reformation that is Christ, should be a giant red flag.

teachings.title: O wretched man that I am
teachings.summary: False prophets use Romans 7 to teach repent-of-your-sins works salvation or sinless living, but they deceive themselves and produce only fruit-inspecting hypocrites.
teachings.text:
*O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?*

Some false prophets use Romans 7 to teach a works-based, repent of your sins salvation. They use similar verses to teach that if you have sin you aren't saved. They will even claim they themselves are without sin.

**1 John 1:8**
*If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.*

**Revelation 22**
*But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone: which is the second death.*

These people are vipers. They have a false gospel. They produce no fruit, just bitter people unable to ever come to perfection, and trusting in their own works to save them.

Or worse, they make hypocrites, "fruit inspectors," who spend their time being holier than thou and touting their own righteousness, and glorying in their separation, but who never do the actual works of the spirit. Who can't win someone to Christ. At best, if they believed at one point, they create nothing but wood, hay and stubble.

But most aren't believers and just bring filthy rags before the judgment seat of Christ, saying *Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?*

And He will say to them, depart from me I never knew you.

teachings.title: Works religion as power over men
teachings.summary: Works-based religion gives leaders power over a fearful people, which is why the gospel of grace was persecuted then and is opposed by Rome and Lordshippers today.
teachings.text:
The Gospel of grace through faith, not of works of the law was why the Jews sought to slay Christ Jesus, **John 5**;

*And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day. But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work. Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God. Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise. For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel. For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will. For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son: that all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him. Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life. Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live. For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself; and hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man. Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice, and shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation. I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.*

Those who teach a works-based false religion have control over a fearful population that looks to the religious leaders to tell them if they are doing good, if they are absolved, what the rules are that they may be saved by vain works and traditions of men. It is a form of political power, and because the leaders seek to maintain power, they add too and take away from God's law to satisfy the will of the masses, while still maintaining control with the yoke of the law.

The Gospel of grace through faith, the free gift of salvation that is liberty from the burden of the works of the law, destroys the hold these men maintain on the people. **Acts 17**;

*But the Jews which believed not, moved with envy, took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set all the city on an uproar, and assaulted the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people. And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also*.

The freedom we have in Christ was a threat to their power structure. And it still is to this day, to all who teach works-based salvation.

Judaizing never stopped. And those of you who are saved by faith through grace witness this same pushback today as you give the gospel.

To the people taken in by the false gospel, who are under the yoke of the law and subject to the authority of men, primarily in the Catholic Church and its daughters, and even in the evangelical movement, Lordshippers and the like, the appeal of works is they never have to confront the truth that they aren't good enough, that there are none righteous, that they are going to Hell.

teachings.title: Their throat is an open sepulchre
teachings.summary: Romans 3 and Psalm 14 show that none is righteous and that false teachers, like the Pharisees, devour people with a deadly false gospel.
teachings.text:
And so, Paul is writing to the churches in Rome, many of the congregation are saved Jews, surrounded by reprobate pagan excess and put upon by Pharisees among their own people.

He established that the Gentiles were beholden to the same Creator. He established that the law wasn't sufficient to save the Jew. He established that all are under sin.

And so we begin to get to the meat of things.

*There is none righteous, no, not one: There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.*
*They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.*

This is quoting **Psalm 14**;

*The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that doeth good. The Lord looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek God. They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth good, no, not one. Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon the Lord. There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous. Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the Lord is his refuge.*

*Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the Lord bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.*

The workers of iniquity, those whose *mouths are an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lip*; those teaching men false doctrines, their words are like the stench of death, of an open grave, because that is what their false gospel brings. It is poison.

They eat the people up as bread, that they don't call upon the name of the Lord and be saved.

This should sound familiar.

**Matthew 23**;
*14 Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.*

*15 Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.*

*16 Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!*

*17 Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?*

*18 And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.*

*19 Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?*

*20 Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.*

*21 And whoso shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.*

*22 And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.*

*23 Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.*

*24 Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.*

*25 Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.*

*26 Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.*

*27 Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men's bones, and of all uncleanness.*

*28 Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.*

*29 Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,*

teachings.title: There is one gospel
teachings.summary: Galatians was written against Judaizers who demanded the law and slandered Paul, and the same attacks on Paul recur today, but anyone bringing another gospel is accursed.
teachings.text:
Everyone should really read this introduction to the Epistle to the various churches throughout Galatia.

Paul is writing to churches he founded on the gospel, the only good news that we are forgiven all sin and given eternal life through the life, death and resurrection of Jesus Christ, the Son of God. He is writing them because Jews have come behind him, telling the Gentile believers they must follow the law and be circumcised to be saved. Trying to drag who they can back to bondage. To judaize the churches, and to damn the people who had believed in vain, never really trusting in Christ alone.

And these judaizers had badmouthed Paul, claiming he wasn't a real Apostle, that he preached a different Gospel than Peter and even than Jesus Christ.

Sound familiar?

(It's a trend in our circles and on pol, for example, that comes around like clockwork every few months. There are patterns to heresy. They come in waves.)

Discrediting Paul, who God chose to give the authoritative theology for people saved by faith, Jew or Greek, to write the afterwards and lay out everything that came before it and the implications for a Christian life, just as James, Jude, Peter and John.

For there is one gospel and anyone bringing another is accursed.

And the Apostles agreed with Paul when he went to them in Acts about this very thing, which prompted those other epistles and more like them not in scripture.

teachings.title: The trap of works religion and faithless religion
teachings.summary: Works-based religions keep people trapped in sin by trying to justify themselves, while faithless Sadducee-like religion is equally a trap, and Christ calls men to repent of both.
teachings.text:
The hopelessness in hypocrisy of works-based religions, like much of what is considered modern Christianity. Like what is called Judaism. Like what is the religion of the Pharisees. This is such a snare and a trap, as it keeps people mired in their sin, unable to come to forgiveness while they're in their flesh. Because our flesh, our natural man, our old man willfully sins. It's our nature. And as long as people are trapped in a cycle of trying to justify themselves to God by turning from their sin, or engaging in ceremony and sacrament, denying themselves the healing power of Jesus, they become trapped. This stumbling block and snare keeps so many people from even attempting to get right with God.

And the faithless religion of the sadducees, which denies the power of God, the promise of Heaven, the Resurrection in Christ and forgiveness of sins, is equally a trap.

Many who rationalize their way into atheism, reform theology, Calvinism, the catechism of the Roman Catholic church, or the so-called apostolic traditions of the Orthodox, who don't take a literal view of the Bible while adopting the trappings of it, seeking to become righteous in their own wisdom and knowledge, rather than the wisdom and knowledge of the Lord.

These false ways and spiritual traps are what Jesus came to call sinners to repent of that they may be healed. That their sins be forgiven, that they may sin no more.

teachings.title: Judaizers: Satan's main play
teachings.summary: The repeated New Testament warnings against Judaizers, law-keeping, dietary rules and holy days show this is Satan's main attack on the churches.
teachings.text:
Paul is again writing to warn the churches of the Judaizers, who were demanding a return to Hebrew roots by the newly grafted Gentiles, adherence to the Law, the carnal ordinances and the circumcision of the flesh. The acts and works and vain traditions of men, dietary laws, esteeming days over others, all done away with in Christ as they were a foreshadowing of Him.

This is told to us, over and over again, because it is Satan's main play against us. Giant red flags that should warn us of false preachers who creep in among us to lead some astray. It is the bulk of the NT outside the Gospel by which we are saved for a reason. Even more so than instruction against sin, Paul and James and Peter and Jude write to warn the churches to avoid these doctrines of men and appeal to the flesh, and remind us we are of a spiritual circumcision.

teachings.title: The freeborn sons and the bondage of works
teachings.summary: Believers trusting Christ alone are freeborn joint heirs, and any church adding sacraments or works to grace is accursed and holds people in bondage.
teachings.text:
We who are believers, who place our trust in Christ alone for salvation, are the freeborn sons, and joint heirs to the Kingdom, who, the Bible says, Jesus is not ashamed to call brothers.

Those seeking to add any kind of works to this adoption are trying to keep you in bondage, and cast out of the inheritance. Judaizers, who have been disowned are constantly attacking the Gospel of adoption in grace. Be it by adding sacraments, works of the law, superstition, idolatry, or anything other than faith.

If the denomination or church you attend adds things to the Gospel of grace through faith, however they try to argue it's not, they are accursed. There is no salvation within them, only bondage and death.

teachings.title: O foolish Galatians
teachings.summary: Those who add law, repentance from sin, rites or traditions to the gospel are foolish Galatians, and most of Christendom does so and is given over to blindness so they cannot see faith alone in plain scripture.
teachings.text:
O foolish Galatians! Here, a picture of those adding works to the salvation of faith, the Galatians represent many calling themselves Christian today. Those adding works of the law, repentance from sin, rites and rituals, vain traditions of men, foolish genealogies and every other thing to the simple Gospel of Christ Jesus crucified. Allowing others to preach a false gospel to them, and by foolishly accepting it among them, make whatever travails they have in Jesus name, received in vain.

Understand that those called by His name will be persecuted the same whether they believe the Gospel or not. Whether they are justified by the blood or perishing under the law. And the works that they do for righteousness earn them nothing. No rewards because they will burn up with them in their sin, accursed by their faith in themselves under the law.

Paul asks have they, having begun in the Spirit, by hearing the word, think they can be made complete and righteous enough for heaven by their flesh? It's foolishness.

99% of Christianity today believe this foolish thing, and damn themselves in their foolishness. And preferring their foolishness to the wisdom of God, God gives them their delusion, with spiritual blindness that makes them, when reading passages like Galatians 2 and 3, with plain hard language telling them the salvation is by faith alone, unable to see it. They cannot hear it. They cannot believe the report.

teachings.title: One gospel preached by Paul and the apostles
teachings.summary: Galatians and Acts 15 show Paul preached the same faith-alone gospel the apostles agreed on, against the Judaizers then and Hebrew roots and works teachers now.
teachings.text:
The letter to the Galatians regarding the false gospel of works brought to them by judaizers, specifically that they must keep circumcision to be saved, contrary to the gospel of grace Paul had won them with.

Paul in chapter 1 and 2 establishes his bona fides in this, that he preaches the same Gospel the Apostles have, not having learned it from them but the Spirit, and confirming it much later, following the meeting with the elders and the council in Jerusalem, written about in **Acts 15**, which followed a similar incident of judaizers preaching circumcision in Antioch.

If you recall, James, the half brother of Jesus Christ and Peter agreed with Paul that this burden of the carnal ordinances of the law must not be required of the Gentiles, least they frustrate the faith alone Gospel they stand by, that saved them.

*Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.*
*And God, which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Ghost, even as he did unto us; And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.*

*Now therefore why tempt ye God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear? But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they.*

This, in one accord, James agreed; *James answered, saying, Men and brethren, hearken unto me:*

*Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name. And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written, After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, saith the Lord, who doeth all these things. Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world.*
*Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God: But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood.*

There was an idea that Paul changed the nature of the Gospel, removing works from it, and this is something that persists to this day, especially with very online pseudo-Christians, who are taken in by those adding works to salvation, or worse, Hebrew roots heresy, adding the specific ordinance of circumcision and other physical requirements to the faith. But in Acts, and here in Galatians, for example, we see that there has been one faith preached, consistently and that Paul was approved of by the 'pillars' of the early church, even to the shame of Peter, having been being a respecter of persons regarding the Jews in Antioch, and his repentance before Paul, James and the others in Jerusalem.

teachings.title: Another gospel, let him be accursed
teachings.summary: Any religion that mixes works, adds to faith or credits anything but the blood of Jesus preaches another gospel and is accursed, for we are saved by grace alone through faith alone in Christ alone.
teachings.text:
Straightforward introduction from Paul, focusing on on the topic at hand, false gospels spread in Galatia, and his experience in knowledge of God through revelation, not by man.

Paul's establishment in the scriptures made him more the zealous for the tradition of man he followed in persecution of believers, but also primed him to understanding of how they were fulfilled in Jesus Christ.

All knowledge and wisdom comes from God, by the Spirit and the Word.

And those that bring a false doctrine of man, to preach another means of salvation other than the truth of God's grace, the gift given to those that believe on the perfect work of Christ to cleanse us of sin and justify us in His righteousness unto eternal life, sealed by the Spirit, is accursed. And Paul says it again so there's no mistaking his intent; they are accursed.

Every false religion that mixes works, adds to faith, takes away grace or credits anything other than the blood of Jesus for our righteousness and salvation is accursed.

The Bible says we are saved by God's grace alone in faith alone in Christ alone, received while we were yet sinners, reborn a new man in the spirit by the indwelling of the Holy Ghost, and this gift of God grants us eternal life that can never be lost.

teachings.title: Loving the truth and hating every false way
teachings.summary: David's psalms of trust are models of prayer that Christ Himself quoted, and loving God's truth, a gift of the Spirit, means hating false prophets who teach damnable heresy while loving those they mislead enough to tell them the truth.
teachings.text:
**Luke 23:46**
*And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.*

David's Psalms of trust in the Lord God, to be delivered and never ashamed, redeemed in His righteousness, are models of prayer, and Jesus upon the cross quotes them (or rather, they quote Him). How much more should we?

The cries to listen to our prayers and save us out of trouble, acknowledging that He is our rock and our fortress, our Savior, our ready help in time of tribulation, they echo through time and are as relevant to Christians today as they were to the King of Israel, and the congregation that sang them 3,000 years ago.

*Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.*

Trusting the God of truth to keep His word, having faith in His promises, is the foundation for our Christian life. Relying on His word to feed us with truth. Knowing the truth that sets us free.

And loving the truth puts us in a position where we hate those that lie about the Lord.

**Psalm 119:104**
*Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.*

This love of the truth and understanding of His word is a gift of the Spirit of God.

**1 John 4:6**
*We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he that is not of God heareth not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.*

All things are made known to us by the Spirit, through Christ who is the way, the truth, the light.

And so we should be vexed by false prophets who teach damnable heresy.

**1 Timothy 4:1–2**
*Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils; Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron*

These false prophets are reprobates concerning the faith. Their lies make their followers twofold more the child of Hell than themselves. They are enemies of God, and we should hate them with a perfect hatred, while loving those misled by them enough to proclaim the truth.

teachings.title: He that turneth away his ear from the law
teachings.summary: Those who use liberty in grace to excuse sin and teach that God is not mad at sin have abominable prayers, while believers should affirm the law and abstain so as not to make the weak stumble.
teachings.text:
**Proverbs 28** continues.

**Verse 9**; *He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.*

The law-haters out there, who allow the reality of grace and reconciliation in Christ to then turn their ear from the hearing of the law, should consider this saying. Their prayers are an abomination to God.

To take our liberty and use it as a cover for sin, is wicked. Rather it is a cause to cleanse ourselves, as much as possible, and to not lead those weak in the faith to stumble.

**1 Corinthians 10:23-24** 
*All things are lawful for me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but all things edify not. Let no man seek his own, but every man another's wealth.*

We should be a model of the law, that it convicts the unsaved, and serves to edify our brethren, weak in the faith, to do better. Not as a stumbling block or a snare, but as an example. Not being offended at the hearing of the law, but affirming it, that it may bring others to Christ. That our prayers are acceptable to the Lord.

You might not be perfect, and we all fall short, but preaching against sin, especially the sin you still do, shouldn't offend you. It should convict. It should elicit an even hardier "Amen!"

It's no wonder that **verse 10** follows;

*Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good things in possession.*

**Romans 14** warns of causing a brother to sin by your liberty.

**Romans 14:14-16;21**
*I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean. But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died. Let not then your good be evil spoken of*... *It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.*

If matters of conscience are left to us to determine, yet we should defer to abstain for the edification of those weak in faith, how much more so the clear things of the law which are sin?

So, those who take liberty to be libertine, and who teach that the redundant term "free grace" means "God isn't mad at your sin," to then allow fornication, drunkenness and the like, misleading others, will themselves fall victim to their sin. God will repay.

And those that deliberately bring offense, who corrupt and pervert others into sin, they will fall themselves into the pit they've dug for others. They will be snared by their own trap.

Better to have standards, to teach the whole counsel of God. To love the law and delight in it, even at liberty by grace. To put the profit of others before your own lusts and desires. To not give others cause to blaspheme the Lord. For the upright shall have good things in possession. They shall be blessed.

teachings.title: They that forsake the law praise the wicked
teachings.summary: Law-haters who use grace to excuse sin go on to praise the wicked, sodomites and rioters, while believers keep the law, abhor evil and honour the powers that be.
teachings.text:
What follows, from verse 3 though 28, is a litany of sayings that contrast the wicked, the rich without understanding, the haters of the law, the violent and bloody man, with the faithful, upright, keepers of the law. The prince of understanding, the righteous man, these see their fortunes and their reputation in increase, while their counterparts are undone by their sin.

We see that a poor man who helps oppress the poor is a threat to all, and also self-destructive.

That those who forsake the law will praise the wicked, but this that keep the law will contend with them. Those law-haters out there, that make grace an opportunity to justify their sin, will inevitably go after the praise of the wicked. We see it all the time. It begins with excusing themselves from God's precepts, and extends to then justifying sodomites and degenerates. Female led churches with rainbow flags, glorifying rioting and rebellion, and teaching abominations.

Because evil men understand not judgment, they are perverse and so oppose any mention of what God says, to chase after their own lusts. "God wouldn't want the death penalty!" or "A loving God wouldn't send anyone to Hell!" Those that seek the Lord and in all our ways acknowledge Him, understand the need for love being without dissimulation. Why we must abhor that which is evil.

We are reminded again it is better to be poor and walking in God's ways, than to be rich and wicked.

A wise son keeps the law and is a joy to his parents, but the riotous and rebellious son is a shame to his father.

**Romans 13:13**-**14**
*Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.* *But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.*

As Christians, we are to give honor, tribute and custom to whom it is due. To obey the higher authority and the powers that be. Not seek cause for lawlessness and giving the wicked praise because they cause the righteous to go astray unto evil.

teachings.title: Untempered mortar and peace, peace
teachings.summary: False prophets who tell people they are safe in their sins, like Osteen and Joyce Meyer today, will be exposed and made ashamed.
teachings.text:
The word of the Lord comes against the false prophets of the kan, saying "Peace, peace" when there is no peace. Who tell the people they are safe in their sins. That God's judgment isn't upon them.

God compares them to someone who applied bad, untempered mortar to a wall. The wall easily collapses. God promises to expose them just as this, that they be ashamed before the people they lied to.

Then He tells Ezekiel to preach against the women who prophesy from their own hearts, the daughters of Israel who are pillows to all armholes and make kerchiefs upon the head of every statue, large and small to hunt souls. To entrap men until them with lies.

I don't know what the significance of these adornments means, other than it seems to be a style of comfort and beauty of whores or priestesses of Babylon, who lead good men to lust, who turn others against the righteous, and who prop up the evil with their lies. And they do it for very little material gain, they just enjoy corrupting the people.

But in the end all false teachers are exposed and the people are made to know He is the Lord. The same today as in Ezekiel's day. The Osteens and Joyce Myers/"God isn't mad at you!" crowd.

They will be made ashamed. Their names will not be in the books of our people. Those they misled will cry against them in their torment. They will be made to know He is the Lord.

teachings.title: Priests that teach for hire
teachings.summary: Micah's false prophets who preach peace for money are today's feel-good preachers like Joel Osteen and the Catholic church, who put riches above truth and are under God's wrath.
teachings.text:
**Micah 3** turns the prophet's focus on the false teachers and prophets, and the people who, having itching ears and wishing to not hear the word of God, but soothing things, justifying their sin.

The violence of what they are doing is conveyed as flaying skin and biting with their teeth, breaking bones and devouring them.

As Jesus preached in **Matthew 23:14-15**
*Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation. Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.*

The seers and diviners will be made ashamed, their prophecy and predictions failing. They will seek God, and there will be no answer.

*The heads thereof judge for reward, and the priests thereof teach for hire, and the prophets thereof divine for money: yet will they lean upon the Lord, and say, Is not the Lord among us? none evil can come upon us.*

For filthy lucre's sake, they give the false sense of security and peace with God, while allowing the abominations of the people run wild. Joel Osteen and the like do it today. Feel-good, hollowed-out, carnal Christianity. The Catholics and other denominations, putting their accumulation of riches and power above the truth of God. That abhor judgment, and pervert all equity, building up blood against the nations. The wrath of God is upon them. And all will be settled by His rod of iron. Amen.

teachings.title: Peace, peace when there is no peace
teachings.summary: True men of God preach hard warnings of judgment as Zephaniah did, while false prophets today, seeker sensitive, prosperity and LGBTQ affirming churches, preach pleasant peace.
teachings.text:
**Jeremiah 23:16-17**
*Thus saith the Lord of hosts, Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you: they make you vain: they speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of the Lord. They say still unto them that despise me, The Lord hath said, Ye shall have peace; and they say unto every one that walketh after the imagination of his own heart, No evil shall come upon you.*

When we read the words of the prophets in the Bible, they preach hard against sin and corruption and false ways that man has devised. They tell of the pending judgment of the Lord against the wicked. They tell kings and nations that the wrath is come upon them. Zephaniah preaching in the time before the Babylonian captivity, during the time of Jeremiah and Habakkuk and others, clearly and with power explains what God is going to do to Judah.

We can tell the false prophets, Jeremiah says, by their preaching pleasant things that are easy on the ears, preaching "Peace, peace" when there is no peace. That "God is love" and He doesn't judge you, continue in your sin.

The world is full of these false prophets today. New Evangelicals and "progressive" Christians and even in some formerly hard preaching Baptist circles. The "seeker sensitive" churches and big time "prosperity Gospel" grifters. The skinny jeans and laser shows and rock concert "worship services," that are "LGBTQ Welcoming" and that push for abortion, broken homes, that biblical families are "oppressive," and teach fornication isn't always a sin.

But God's word is clear:

*I will utterly consume all things from off the land, saith the Lord.*

Speaking through Zephaniah, the Lord promises that He will cut off the remnant of Baal from the land, the idols and priests, those that worship the stars and the things of heaven, who give lip service to the Lord while swearing to the gods of the Canaanites. Those who seek Him not, and those that refused to seek Him on His terms but made up their own paths.

The Lord says that nothing will protect them. Not the walls of the cities, not the caverns they dwell in. That the things they build for themselves they will not partake in. None of their wealth or the things they trusted in over Him will save them from His wrath.

*Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of the Lord's wrath; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy: for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land.*

That's how you can identify a true man of God. They preach hard, a warning, using the word of the Lord, that man may come to repentance and turn towards Him for salvation and mercy, in the hour of tribulation against the righteous, the profit of the wicked and the wrath that follows. Amen

teachings.title: Death in the pot
teachings.summary: The wild gourds that poisoned the pottage picture false teachers bringing damnable heresies into a church, which the preached word of God cleanses.
teachings.text:
Next, we find Elisha in Gilgal, where there is a famine in the land. He tells his servant to set a pot for pottage, to make a stew to feed the sons of the prophets, (again a term meaning believers or disciples, in my opinion).

*And one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered thereof wild gourds his lap full, and came and shred them into the pot of pottage: for they knew them not.*

They go to eat and realize that the gourds of the wild vine have apparently poisoned the stew. The allegory here shows how a group of saved believers, of the true vine that is Christ, welcoming in the fruit of a wild vine, can lead to death. *O thou man of God, there is death in the pot. And they could not eat thereof.*

Just as Peter warns the churches of Christ in the NT;

**2 Peter 2:1-2**
*But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction. And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of.*

But Elisha adds to the stew some meal, the ground barley that makes bread, and casts it into the pot, and makes it safe to eat again.

Just as the word of God preached, the daily bread, can cleanse a church of the false doctrines of false teachers.

teachings.title: Itching ears in perilous times
teachings.summary: In tribulation proud men with itching ears follow false teachers who cry peace, peace, as megachurch and television preachers lead people back to Egypt.
teachings.text:
And so when there is tribulation and calamity and imminent destruction, perilous times that shall come, there will be proud men like Azariah and Johanan, with itching ears, unwilling to hear the truth, and turning away to their own devices. And their folly becomes manifest as they are swiftly destroyed.

Just as today, there are false teachers who gather huge followings, in the megachurches and television ministries, preaching lies and damnable heresies. Telling the people "peace, peace," when there is no peace. Leading the people to Egypt, spiritually, and so to their own destruction.

And the greater the impending doom, the greater the tribulation, the more evil men and seducers there will be, waxing worse and worse. Deceiving and being deceived.

Just as there is great opportunity for revival in tribulation, and many will seek the Lord sincerely and humbly when faced with troubles, so too is there always a falling away. Apostasy. False prophets, itching ears and a willingness to be lied to if it feels good, despite the clear word of God.

teachings.title: Peace, peace, when there is no peace
teachings.summary: False prophets preach peace, prosperity and a pre-tribulation escape to itching ears, but true preachers warn of judgment and call men to repent and find peace only in Christ.
teachings.text:
**Jeremiah 6:13-15**
*For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely. They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace. Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore they shall fall among them that fall: at the time that I visit them they shall be cast down, saith the Lord.*

**1 Thessalonians 5:1-3**
*But of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you. For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night. For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.*

False prophets, claiming to speak the words of God, come with soothing words of peace. Peace with God, despite the sins of the people. Peace with the land, despite the blood of innocents. Peace with those who practice Idolatry and wickedness, in ecumenicalism.

They preach prosperity and health to people with itching ears.

**2 Timothy 4:3-4**
*For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears; and they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.*

Today, many false prophets also claim that believers won't see tribulation, but rather will be spared destruction, raptured before it begins.

But what does Jeremiah say to Hannah? *The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.*

Prophets who come with the word of God preach destruction and repentance.

And, in like manner, today we have the word of God, and we are called to do the same.

**Jude 1:22-23**
*And of some have compassion, making a difference: and others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.*

We preach the acceptable year of the Lord. That judgment is coming to every man, and Hell with it. To repent towards God and faith in His Son for deliverance. That man cannot know peace except in Christ. These are the word of God given us in scripture with the command to love one another, to set at liberty from the bonds of the law. To reconcile man with God before it's too late.

**Matthew 11:28-30**
*Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.*

teachings.title: Filthy dreamers preaching good things
teachings.summary: Like Jeremiah's false prophets, today's prophets of prosperity, a third temple and blessing the Jews keep men under false hope.
teachings.text:
**Jeremiah 25:11**
*And this whole land shall be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.*

God has preached through Jeremiah of the spoiling of Jerusalem, which has taken place at this point, with the promise that the captivity under Babylon was to chastise Judah, and would last only 70 years. That He would restore them, and deliver Judah to rebuild His house. A prophecy fulfilled as seen in Ezra;

**Ezra 1:7**
*Also Cyrus the king brought forth the vessels of the house of the Lord, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought forth out of Jerusalem, and had put them in the house of his gods;*

False prophets in Jerusalem and throughout the neighboring kingdoms kept preaching of good things to itching ears. Including the diviners and mediums and "dreamers," who claimed to speak for God or for gods.

The Lord says he will bless these other kingdoms to not suffer captivity if they serve Babylon as a tributary. Babylon has to flourish that God's glory may be revealed.

Today there are false prophets keeping men under false hope, never to see God's glory. That there is no tribulation for the Christian life. That wealth and prosperity are all they will know. That a 3rd temple should be built and that God's wrath isn't upon the Jews. That we must bless them. These filthy dreamers, who claim God came to them in a vision, that their personal revelations should be heeded.

But the yoke of God is not upon them.

teachings.title: The Doctrine of Balaam in Pergamos
teachings.summary: The doctrine of Balaam is leading God's people into fornication and idol sacrifices to bring His judgment on them, as at Baalpeor, and Pergamos suffered it.
teachings.text:
*And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write; These things saith he which hath the sharp sword with two edges;*

And so, to the church at Pergamum, from Jesus, the twoedged sword that proceeds out of His mouth, the word of God.

*I know thy works, and where thou dwellest, even where Satan's seat is: and thou holdest fast my name, and hast not denied my faith, even in those days wherein Antipas was my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwelleth.*

Pergamum was host to the main temple of Zeus, the altar to this false god was his "throne." Because of how strong the pagan religion was in the city, the Christians who professed the truth of the living God were subject to tribulation, harsh persecution even the martyrdom of one of their own, Antipas. These believers held fast, to declare the name of Jesus among the pagans.

It is common to think of paganism as the religion of the wild barbarian. But the worship of dead idols in glorious temples made of marble and gold, their graven images and fancy altars, in the Hellenistic world (and today), is often the religion of the civilized. The superstitious nature of natural man leaves them wide open to attack by Satan, and his throne can be found in many advanced cultures as much as it is in the woods and huts of the savage.

*But I have a few things against thee, because thou hast there them that hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balac to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed unto idols, and to commit fornication.*

The doctrine of Balaam refers to the soothsaying false prophet from the OT, who appears in **Deuteronomy, Joshua** and **Numbers,** the son of Beor, a Mesopotamian false prophet who is seemingly familiar with the true God of Israel. He is sent for by Balak, the king of Moab to curse the Israelites who were warring against him in return for treasure. God prevents this in various ways, despite Balaam's best efforts to, he ends up blessing the Israelites. Balaam suggests finally that the Moabites could get Israel to sin, and that would bring God's disfavor on them. Specifically, he tells them to lead them to fornication with their daughters offered as whores, and then have the women lead them in their concupiscence to eating offerings to idols.

We see the success of this in **Numbers 25**:

*And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab. And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.*
*And Israel joined himself unto Baalpeor: and the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel. And the Lord said unto Moses, Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up before the Lord against the sun, that the fierce anger of the Lord may be turned away from Israel.*

*And Moses said unto the judges of Israel, Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baalpeor. And, behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, who were weeping before the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.*

*And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from among the congregation, and took a javelin in his hand; And he went after the man of Israel into the tent, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her belly. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel. And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.*

We see an admonition against chasing after the error of Balaam in **2 Peter 2**:

*Spots they are and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you; Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children: Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness; But was rebuked for*

teachings.title: An hundredfold now, with persecutions
teachings.summary: The hundredfold promise is fellowship, homes and spiritual family among believers along with persecutions, not the material riches the prosperity false gospel teaches.
teachings.text:
*Then Peter began to say unto him, Lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.*

*And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel's, But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.*

*But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.*

This follows the rich young man, who bidden to leave his material wealth and follow Jesus, declines, even though the potential for eternal life presents itself, (for this was what he was asking on, and Jesus knowing his heart so tested him)

The apostles wondered at the saying that if someone like the rich young man couldn't enter into Heaven, who then can? And Jesus replied no man can, but with God all things are possible. Amen.

But now, Peter who isn't the quickest, has it dawn on him that they all have done exactly this. They've left behind their families and trade and possessions to follow Christ.

And here Jesus makes a promise, as Lord. He says those that have sacrificed of this world for His sake and the furtherance of the Gospel shall receive 100 fold on this earth.  Gaining houses, family, children and lands, and of course the gift of eternal life in the next world.

Some twisted vipers take this to a covetous and greedy place, pushing a prosperity false gospel. That God will make you a millionaire of you do good works. But this is not what Jesus says.

First, this perversion ignores the "persecutions" part. 100 fold in all these things, and persecutions. Tribulations. These false teachers claim that tribulation and persecution are signs of God's judgment against people. An answer for sin. They think they are entitled to comfort and riches, being holier than thou. It's sick.

But further, Jesus isn't saying we are blessed with material wealth. He says we will have houses and lands. Those of fellow believers, those of different lands. Just as He told them when first sending them out to preach the Gospel, from Mark 6:

*And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits; and commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse: But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats. And he said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place*.

They had homes and lands and their needs met, 100 fold and more. And as for family, as Jesus said when His half-brothers and sisters and mother came to see Him;

W*hosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.*

Just as the Apostles write in their epistles, those who they have brought to Christ are their children, sons in Jesus who they have begotten with the Gospel.

This is the blessing of wealth and family those who abandon everything and suffer for His sake receive here on earth, along with the persecution that brings them rewards in Heaven.

*Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man's sake.*
...
*If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are ye; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.*
...
*Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:*

*But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:*

*For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.*

teachings.title: Judge righteously and know false prophets by their fruit
teachings.summary: Christians are to judge righteously after removing their own beam, and the fruit by which false prophets are known is their followers and lack of soul winning, not self-righteous fruit inspection.
teachings.text:
Matthew 7 contains some of the most quoted, and misquoted red-letter scripture of the Gospels. The culmination of Jesus' preaching at the mount. He warns of hypocrisy in judgement, not considering your sin as you cast judgment on another's.

Many cite this as meaning never judge another, but we who are saved by faith are called to judge even the angels. It's in God's law, His word that we express judgement having already been judged, found wanting, and healed and made whole in Christ.

 But hypocrites, the saved especially, will face reproach for the lack of grace and self-awareness they show others. We judge in God's word, with the same mercy He has shown us in our sin. Removing the beam from our eye that we may help remove the mote in our brother's. Righteous judgement.

Jesus warns against reprobates, dogs. Swine. Ministering unto them the things of God, that gives them an opening to destroy you. I consider churches that accept sodomites into their midst examples of this. "They repented!" and 2 years later they are arrested for molestation in a church's youth group. Many such cases, and even the best church can fall prey to this.

Everyone who asks of the Father, spiritual things, be it salvation, wisdom, knowledge, blessings...God will give. This is a promise from Christ Himself. Everyone means everyone. No special boys, but *whosoever* will come to call upon the name of the Lord.

In all things, if you want men to live upright and Godly, start with yourself. It is the ultimate implication of loving thy neighbor as thyself. Again, judgment without hypocrisy. Being blameless. We turn a nation towards God by being Godly ourselves, and letting His light shine through us to guide others knocking, seeking truth, to Him. It allows us to remove the beam, and help others with their mote.

Stay on the strait and narrow. Don't look for shortcuts into heaven than the path of salvation laid out in the Gospel. It is an easy way, but most people carry burdens that prevents them from entering.

Beware false prophets, ravenous wolves seeking to destroy. You can identify them, despite their sheep's clothing, by the fruit they produce. This is what true fruit inspection means.

Too many false prophets turn this scripture on its head, and produce hypocrites, self-righteous fruit inspectors, judging the motes in everyone's eye but ignoring the beams they have themselves. We are to judge if a pastor or church leader, a prophet or preacher is false or not by inspection of their fruit. Their followers. Are they loving and saved, humble and meek? Hypocrites and holier than thou? Good fruit or poison? And from there, knowing that a good tree brings forth good fruit, and that the unsaved and corrupted cannot bring someone to salvation and truth, evaluate the man claiming to be of God.

A very quick way to evaluate this is lack of actual soul winning. The more a false pastor misleads their flock, the less evangelism they will engage in. It's not the sole metric, and doesn't always hold true (JW for example), but it is one means of recognition. But if their fruit isn't producing good fruit after its kind, but rather engaged in judging and works of self-righteousness, focusing on themselves rather than others, this is thistles not figs.

These works-based false teachers have sacraments and rites, idols and vain traditions that create wide paths and broad gates, where those on it see an easier path, that ultimately leads to destruction.

All of their works focus on themselves. The sacraments they perform are selfish, their rosaries and novenas, about them. Trying to save themselves from the pits of Hell, rather than genuine charity and love. And they never win a soul to Christ. They can't produce fruit meet for repentance.

They claim to cast out devils and bless houses, while laying up treasure for themselves here on Earth. And thus burdened, are unable to fit through the strait gate and unable to walk the narrow way.

teachings.title: The remnant are not chosen but seek Him
